en.description: Take over heaven in this airborne-combat roguelike where you fight hordes of angels while growing stronger every minute.

games.name: A Thousand Cloys
games.description: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.

en.name: A Thousand Cloys
en.description: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.

games.name: Incremental RTS
games.description: Semi-idle incremental RTS. You don’t micro units. You build factories, pick upgrades and let your army flood the battlefield. Start with nothing, research tanks, artillery, flankers and mega units. Scale and survive enemy surges. Pure auto-battle chaos.

en.name: Incremental RTS
en.description: Semi-idle incremental RTS. You don’t micro units. You build factories, pick upgrades and let your army flood the battlefield. Start with nothing, research tanks, artillery, flankers and mega units. Scale and survive enemy surges. Pure auto-battle chaos.

games.name: Highschool J
games.description: ユウキは、借金の重荷、わずかな友人、そして誰にも見せない詩と共に、ありふれた日々を送っていた。あの転校生が教室に現れるまでは。抗えない存在がある。ただ、ひれ伏すことしかできないのだ。

en.name: Highschool J
en.description: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, surrounded by a few friends, and consumed by poems shared with no one. Until the arrival of a transfer student. Because some presences cannot be resisted. Only surrender is possible.

games.name: Tidesong
genres: 農場シミュレーション
人生シミュレーション
games.description: 会社勤めをやめて、真鍮の潜水ヘルメットと海底の小さな農場を手に入れよう。ケルプや海ぶどうを育て、ウニやマグロを飼い、サンゴ湾の人魚たちと仲よくなって、色あせた古い礁をよみがえらせる、心やすらぐ海中農業ゲーム。ひとりでも、フレンドとオンライン協力プレイでも遊べます。

en.name: Tidesong
en.description: Trade your office job for a brass diving helmet and a little farm on the sea floor. Grow kelp and sea grapes, raise urchins and tuna, befriend the merfolk of Coral Cove and wake a bleached old reef back to life in this cozy underwater farming game, alone or with a friend in online co-op.

games.name: Network & Cyber Security Simulator
games.description: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!

en.name: Network & Cyber Security Simulator
en.description: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!

games.name: Jurassic Architect
games.description: ポータルの向こう側に、居心地のいい恐竜動物園をつくろう。ひとりでも、最大三人のフレンドと一緒でも。私たちの世界から来た来園者が、本物の恐竜に会うためにチケットを買っていきます。囲いをつくり、50+種を発見して、あなたの恐竜を幸せに保ちましょう。恐竜たちが柵を試しはじめる前に。

en.name: Jurassic Architect
en.description: Build a cozy dinosaur zoo on the far side of a Portal. Visitors from our world buy tickets to meet real dinosaurs. Shape enclosures, discover 50+ species, hire keepers, rangers and vets, and keep your dinosaurs happy before they start testing their fences.

games.name: Sardoinky
games.description: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.

en.name: Sardoinky
en.description: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.

games.name: 你好！我们还有场恋爱没谈2
games.shortName: 你好！我们还有场恋爱没谈2
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
games.description: 2030年、AIパートナーが世界を席巻。記憶を失った感情エンジニアのあなたは、目覚めた途端に恋愛修羅場へ。強気な女性上司、覚醒したAI、反AIの少女、謎のシステムが次々と現れる。選択のたびに運命が変わる——アルゴリズムが導き出した愛も、愛と呼べるのか？

en.name: HelloLove2:Binary
en.description: 2030: AI companions reshape romance. As an emotion engineer with missing memories, you awaken in a tangled love affair. A commanding boss, an awakened AI, an anti-AI rebel, and a mysterious system enter your life. Each choice rewrites fate. Is algorithmic love still love?

games.name: Flick
games.description: 部屋のスイッチを入れると、現実はオフになる。グロテスクな世界へと飛び込み、家族の歪んだ過去を明らかにせよ。このサイコロジカルホラーでは、明かりがなくては進めない。しかし、その光は戦慄の悪夢を呼び寄せる――あなたはこの恐怖から逃げ切れるか？

en.name: Flick
en.description: Flick light switches on and off throughout a long-abandoned house to shift the environment from a safe reality to a horror-filled echo where wicked puzzles manifest. A short psychological horror game where you must balance the light needed to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: Frog Collector
genres: 趣味シミュレーション
games.description: コレクション用のカエルであふれかえったお店を片づけよう。カラフルなフィギュアを拾って仕分け、テーマ別の棚を埋め、便利なアップグレードを解放し、隠されたタマゴを探そう。カエルをひとつずつ集めて、自分だけのコレクションを作り上げよう。

en.name: Frog Collector
en.description: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.

games.name: 再来亿竿 One Last Cast
games.shortName: 再来亿竿 ONE LAST CAST
games.description: 『One Last Cast』は、デスクトップの片隅で世界の釣り場を旅する、ドット絵の放置釣りゲームです。仕事の合間にのぞいてみると、相棒の隣で魚がかかっているかも。釣り具を整え、珍しい色違いの魚を探して、今日もあと一投だけ。

en.name: One Last Cast
en.description: One Last Cast "is a tabletop game. Place the scenery of lakes and mountains in a corner of the screen, and let your friends accompany you to leisurely fish and collect fish species from various places. Encounter rare and exotic fish, complete local commissions, and upgrade fishing equipment

games.name: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life
games.description: 『Rekindled』は、ストレスフリーに楽しめる、ひと味違った協力型酒場経営ゲームです。採集、釣り、農業、そして料理をすべて自分のペースで進めることができます。自慢の料理と酒場を素敵に飾り付けたら、いよいよお客さんをお迎えしましょう。

en.name: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life
en.description: Rekindled is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

games.name: Prison Legacy
games.description: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

en.name: Prison Legacy
en.description: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

games.name: 汪里个狼 Wolf in Woof
games.shortName: 汪里个狼 WOLF IN WOOF
games.description: Wolf in Woof is a single-player Werewolf game where wolves hide among cute dog NPCs. Through speech, suspicion, alliances, voting, and deduction, players must uncover the hidden wolves—enjoying tense mind games without matchmaking or social pressure.

en.name: 汪里个狼 Wolf in Woof
en.description: Wolf in Woof is a single-player Werewolf game where wolves hide among cute dog NPCs. Through speech, suspicion, alliances, voting, and deduction, players must uncover the hidden wolves—enjoying tense mind games without matchmaking or social pressure.

games.name: Pool of Madness
games.description: アップグレード可能なキュー、銃、手順が必要な儀式的ホラー系ローグライトビリヤード。 ボールを撃ち、深淵から湧き出る恐怖を解き放て。狂気に我を忘れて、何度でも挑戦しよう。

en.name: Pool of Madness
en.description: A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals. Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

games.name: 隅っこの魔女
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
games.description: 隅っこの魔女は、画面の隅に表示される、のんびり遊べる放置ゲームです。新しい呪文を研究し、魔法の旅を進めましょう。コスメをアンロックして小さな魔女を着せ替え、レベルアップして強くなりましょう。

en.name: Cornerwitch
en.description: Cornerwitch is a cozy idler game that sits on the corner of your screen. Study new spells and advance through a magical journey. Unlock cosmetics to dress up your little witch, level up and become stronger.

games.name: ELEMENTAIL : エレメンテイル
games.description: 「引いて、飲み込んで、叩け！」 かわいい動物の魔法使いと一緒に、水・火・雷のエレメントカードを戦略的に組み合わせるカジュアルデッキ構築ローグライク――『エレメンテイル』。150種類の遺物を集めて強化し、公爵工作の工房を探検して、汚染された世界を救おう！

en.name: ELEMENTAIL
en.description: Draw it, Store it, Strike hard! A charming casual deckbuilding roguelike with magical animal wizards! Strategically combine elemental cards—Water, Fire, and Lightning—and collect over 150 unique relics to build your deck, customize your playstyle, and save a world tainted by elemental corruption.

games.name: Forge the Fates
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 手持ちのカードをルーン戦術配列へと変換し、駆使して連鎖消去ボーナスを発動させ、強力な連撃を解き放とう！お気に入りの英雄を選び、独自のデッキを構築し、致命的なダンジョンに挑み、神秘的な闇の覇者に立ち向かおう。

en.name: Forge the Fates
en.description: Take deckbuilding to the next level. Transform your hand of cards into a tactical grid of runes. Plan, shift, and strike to unleash powerful combos and chain match-3 bonuses. Choose your hero, master their deck, and fight through deadly dungeons to face a mysterious dark overlord.

games.name: Dejinochi
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
games.description: デスクトップで暮らす、小さなバーチャルペットを育てよう。ごはんをあげて、お世話をしながら成長を見守ると、育て方によってさまざまな姿に成長します。そしていつかは、世界へ巣立つ日がやってきます。でも、昔の友だちがときどき遊びに戻ってくることも。

en.name: Dejinochi
en.description: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, and see what it grows into. Eventually, you'll have to say goodbye as it heads out into the world, but old friends come back to visit.

games.name: Mirklurk: Every Step Matters
games.description: You've been exiled to The Mirk - an unforgiving swampland where every step could be your last. You must constantly make choices: what paths to take, which tree to shelter under, what beasts to engage or avoid, what items to bring into the darkness of dungeons, and what treasures to leave behind.

trailers.name: Mirklurk: Every Step Matters - Official GamePlay Trailer
Mirklurk: Every Step Matters - Official Trailer

en.name: Mirklurk: Every Step Matters
en.description: You've been exiled to The Mirk - an unforgiving swampland where every step could be your last. You must constantly make choices: what paths to take, which tree to shelter under, what beasts to engage or avoid, what items to bring into the darkness of dungeons, and what treasures to leave behind.

games.name: BORE
games.description: 1～4人で遊べるサバイバルホラー。巨大な掘削機を操り、洞窟を探索して貴重品を集め、地下の生物から逃れよう。地上に戻って発見した品を売り、強化や装備の購入に役立てよう。ソロプレイにもオンライン協力プレイにも対応。

en.name: BORE
en.description: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.

games.name: C.L.T.
games.description: A Brazilian top-down crime sandbox inspired by GTA 1, GTA 2 and Chinatown Wars. Steal cars, turn intersections into police pileups and switch between two protagonists. Take jobs, race illegally or grab a helicopter and explore a freshly generated island.

en.name: C.L.T.
en.description: A Brazilian top-down crime sandbox inspired by GTA 1, GTA 2 and Chinatown Wars. Steal cars, turn intersections into police pileups and switch between two protagonists. Take jobs, race illegally or grab a helicopter and explore a freshly generated island.

games.name: Desert Cleaner
games.description: オアシスをきれいにしよう！砂漠の砂をバックパックに集め、砂を金に変えて、綿の手袋から本物の砂嵐までアップグレード。緑のオアシス、隠された宝物、頼れるロボットを掘り起こそう。ソロでも、最大3人のフレンドとのオンライン協力プレイでも楽しめます。

trailers.name: Trailer 2: Treasures, Glizdor and New Game+

en.name: Desert Cleaner
en.description: Tidy up the oasis! Scoop the desert into your backpack, turn sand into gold and upgrade from a cotton glove to a full-blown sandstorm. Uncover a green oasis, hidden treasure and helpful robots, alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

games.name: NGL Biathlon 2027
games.description: NGL Biathlon 2027 is a biathlon simulator. Race as your favourite athlete, develop them in a career from junior to the Big Crystal Globe, build your own tournaments and take on real players online. Every discipline, relays included, and 15 tracks

en.name: NGL Biathlon 2027
en.description: NGL Biathlon 2027 is a biathlon simulator. Race as your favourite athlete, develop them in a career from junior to the Big Crystal Globe, build your own tournaments and take on real players online. Every discipline, relays included, and 15 tracks

games.name: Dance of Elements
genres: ベルトスクロールアクション
games.description: Dance of the Elements is a simple 2D fighter where you control the four basic elements: Fire, Earth, Water, and air. Freely flow between all the elements to fight your friends, AI controlled opponents, or a horde of enemies!

en.name: Dance of Elements
en.description: Dance of the Elements is a simple 2D fighter where you control the four basic elements: Fire, Earth, Water, and air. Freely flow between all the elements to fight your friends, AI controlled opponents, or a horde of enemies!

games.name: CRED
games.description: CRED是一款世界观围绕异常管理组织的科幻剧情叙事游戏。玩家将通过桌面系统模拟界面体验一系列事件，在这个过程中逐步了解关于该组织与世界的真相，并做出抉择。 这段也是

en.name: CRED
en.description: CRED is a sci-fi story-based narrative game with operating-system simulation features and a worldview centered around an ananomaly-management organization. Players will experience a series of events and make fateful choices as they learn more about the organization and the universe it is in.

games.name: Malignus
games.description: ダンジョンそのものになりきって、魔王もミニオンも洞窟の獣たちもまとめて操るコロニーシムです。通路を掘り、凶悪な罠を仕掛けてスイッチにつなぎ、地上を襲撃して財宝を奪います。そして、取り返しに来る冒険者から財宝を守り抜きます。ひとりでも、2～4人の協力プレイでも遊べます。

en.name: Malignus
en.description: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.

games.name: Last Bake
games.description: Last Bakeでは、大晦日にベーカリーで夜間販売員として働く若い女性となります。さまざまなお客様の注文を受けながら、この場所がなぜ祝祭ムードではなく不気味な闇に包まれているのかを解き明かしましょう……

en.name: Last Bake
en.description: You play as a young woman taking a temporary evening job at a bakery on New Year's Eve. Your task is to serve a variety of customers while trying to uncover why, instead of holiday cheer, this place is shrouded in darkness...

games.name: Double Whammy
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 昼はギターショップの店員さん、夜は夢の中でモンスター退治！🎸

en.name: Double Whammy
en.description: Run a guitar shop by day. Smash monsters by night. 🎸

games.name: Swarmbreaker
games.description: 『Swarmbreaker』は、異星の蟲が押し寄せる巨大な生きた波から自軍の拠点を守り抜く、インクリメンタル・タワーディフェンスです。防衛設備を築いて進路を塞ぎ、重火器を展開し、兵装を強化して、群れを打ち砕け！

en.name: Swarmbreaker
en.description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

games.name: Farmer's Diary
genres: 農場シミュレーション
games.description: すべての作業を手作業で行う協力型の農業・クラフトシミュレーション。四季を通じて作物を育て、作業台でパン焼き、製粉、料理をこなし、注文品を届けて仲間と一緒に農場の借金を返済しよう。90年代の田舎町の魅力、近道はなし。

en.name: Farmer's Diary
en.description: A co-op farming and crafting sim for up to 4 players where every job is done by hand. Grow crops through four seasons, work hands-on benches to bake, mill and cook, and deliver orders to pay off the farm's debt together. 90s small-town charm, no shortcuts.

games.name: Food Devils
games.description: あなたは終末後の世界に残された最後の料理人。危険で"おいしい"モンスター料理で冒険者たちを惹きつけ、「デビル契約」を結ばせ、希少な食材を求める遠征を組織しよう！キャラクターをカスタマイズし、理想のレストランを作り上げ、一手一手を考えて挑む戦略ローグライトRPG。

en.name: Food Devils
en.description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Tactics-RPG Roguelite.

games.name: Locked in love : The Office
genres: 選択方式アドベンチャー
没入シミュレーション
games.description: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

en.name: Locked in love : The Office
en.description: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

games.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
games.description: 『楽園追放』シリーズ初のゲーム作品となる完全新作SFビジュアルノベル。電脳世界ディーヴァを離れ、地上で生きることを選んだアンジェラ・バルザック。相棒のディンゴと暮らす彼女のもとに新たな事件が持ち込まれる。物語の要所で揺れるアンジェラの心——その針路を選ぶのはあなただ。選択システム「K2-SYSTEM」が選択の積み重ねを受けとめ、仲間との関係もたどり着く結末も変えていく。彼女がどう選び、何を失うのか。すべての結末は、あなたの選択の先にある。

en.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
en.description: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.

games.name: Escape the Baby Alarm ベビーモニターからの脱出
games.shortName: ESCAPE THE BABY ALARM ベビーモニターからの脱出
games.description: 子育てをテーマにした、心温まるサイケデリックなパズルアドベンチャーです。ベビーモニターの中で手描きの脱出ゲーム風パズルに挑戦しましょう。離乳食やおしゃぶり、眠れない夜からの脱出など、育児の苦悩をユーモアや優しさとともに美しいビジュアルで描いています。

trailers.name: Escape the Baby Alarm - Behind the Scenes

en.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
en.description: Parenthood as told through a cozy, psychedelic, puzzle adventure. Solve hand-drawn escape room-inspired puzzles inside a baby alarm. Find your way out through mashed peas, pacifiers and sleepless nights. Funny, heartfelt, and beautifully illustrated.

games.name: Village Invaders
games.description: 『Village Invaders』は、村を襲撃するテンポの速いローグライト・カードバトル。部隊を配置し、無茶な呪文を放ち、最高のデッキを組み上げて、行く手の王国をすべて叩き潰せ。村は挑むたびに自動生成され、防衛施設も罠も戦利品の位置も毎回変わる。

en.name: Village Invaders
en.description: A fast-paced roguelite card battler where you raid villages. Deploy your army, cast wild spells and build the perfect deck to crush every kingdom in your path.

games.name: Wolfsbanner: Medieval Kingdom RPG
games.description: ロングソードで戦う、容赦なき三人称の近接戦。受け、押し、怯ませ、鎧の敵を血まみれのフィニッシャーで仕留めよ。そして同じ世界で、ロード画面なしに、石を一つずつ積み上げた1403年中央ヨーロッパの生きた町を王として治めよ。

en.name: Wolfsbanner: Medieval Kingdom RPG
en.description: Fight with a longsword in brutal third-person melee: block, shove, stun and finish armored foes in bloody executions. Then rule as king of a living 1403 Central European town you build stone by stone, in the same world, with no loading screen.

games.name: Fleshborn
games.description: A short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a lab from fleshy growths using your flamethrower. Collect resources and spend them in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities.

en.name: Fleshborn
en.description: A short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a lab from fleshy growths using your flamethrower. Collect resources and spend them in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities.

games.name: Witch the Showdown
games.description: パリィ×デッキ構築×ボスラッシュの死にゲーアクション！ 『Witch the Showdown』はボスのみと戦っていく、パリィでマナを貯めて、リアルタイムでカードを使って攻撃するバトルシステムが特徴の、高難易度パリィアクションゲームです！

en.name: Witch the Showdown
en.description: Witch the Showdown is a high-difficulty parry-action game where every battle is a boss fight. Build mana through precise parries, then unleash attacks in real time using your cards—this unique combat system defines the experience.

games.name: Tavern Clicker
games.description: このシンプルなクリッカーゲームで、居心地のよい中世の酒場を経営しよう。個性豊かなお客さんをもてなし、新しい飲み物をアンロックして、仕事を自動化。小さな酒場を王様にふさわしい場所へと育てよう！

en.name: Tavern Clicker
en.description: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

games.name: Gently Packed
genres: 職業シミュレーション
games.description: 『Gently Packed』でレジ係になってみよう。商品をスキャンし、袋詰めし、丁寧にお客様を対応する、リラックスできる店舗経営ゲームです。お店をアップグレードし、プロモーションを実施し、企業の目標を達成して、フランチャイズのローンを返済しましょう。

en.name: Gently Packed
en.description: Step into the shoes of a cashier in Gently Packed, a relaxing store management game where you scan, pack, and serve customers with care. Upgrade your shop, run promotions, meet corporate goals, and pay off your franchise loan.

games.name: Örnöga: Idle & Loot
games.description: Embark on a short magical adventure in Örnöga! Master powerful spells, collect epic loot, and hire mercenaries as you grow from a novice mage to an archwizard. Upgrade your abilities, automate your spellcasting, and watch your power grow... even while you're away.

en.name: Örnöga: Idle & Loot
en.description: Embark on a short magical adventure in Örnöga! Master powerful spells, collect epic loot, and hire mercenaries as you grow from a novice mage to an archwizard. Upgrade your abilities, automate your spellcasting, and watch your power grow... even while you're away.

games.name: Mapping Creator
games.description: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

en.name: Mapping Creator
en.description: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

games.name: KARAKARA3
games.description: "Let us live on this land so arid." Leon's peaceful days suddenly come to an end when he hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage. The final chapter in the KARAKARA series.

en.name: KARAKARA3
en.description: "Let us live on this land so arid." Leon's peaceful days suddenly come to an end when he hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage. The final chapter in the KARAKARA series.

games.name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
games.shortName: PIECE AND QUIET: A STAINED GLASS RESTORA
games.description: ステンドグラスを修復する、心安らぐ一人称視点のゲームです。ほこりをかぶった破片をキレイにし、形と色を見比べながら、山あいの荒れ果てた礼拝堂に6つの美しい窓をよみがえらせましょう。魔法のようなアップグレードを解放しながら、好きなだけ時間をかけてください。パズルには時間制限も、ゲームオーバーもありません。

en.name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
en.description: A cozy first-person game about restoring stained glass. Relax and enjoy cleaning up dusty shards, as you match their shapes and colors, and rebuild six beautiful windows in a ruined mountain chapel. Unlock magical upgrades and take as long as you want, with no deadlines and no way to lose.

games.name: These Eyes
games.description: 『These Eyes』は、アクション、プラットフォームアクション、クエスト、ホラーの要素を取り入れた、テキストフリーのアドベンチャーゲームです。様々な場所を探索し、パズルを解き、他のキャラクターと交流しましょう。

en.name: These Eyes
en.description: These Eyes is a no-text adventure game with elements of action, platforming, quests, and horror. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and interact with other characters.

games.name: Evades X
games.description: Evade your way through danger with friends in the World's Hardest Precision Game!

en.name: Evades X
en.description: Evade your way through danger with friends in the World's Hardest Precision Game!

games.name: Horizon Idle
games.description: A space-themed idle RPG of skilling and crafting. Mine, refine, research, and automate your way from a lone ship to an industrial empire. Level skills to 100, engineer your fleet for auto-battler combat, and Warp to prestige. No energy gates, just numbers that climb forever.

en.name: Horizon Idle
en.description: A space-themed idle RPG of skilling and crafting. Mine, refine, research, and automate your way from a lone ship to an industrial empire. Level skills to 100, engineer your fleet for auto-battler combat, and Warp to prestige. No energy gates, just numbers that climb forever.

games.name: Defender Bros
games.description: 昼間は防御を整え、夜明けまで生き延びろ。《防衛兄弟》は、タワーディフェンス型Roguelikeゲームで、あなたは基地を守る兵士を演じる。レベルが上がるにつれて、さまざまな能力から選択することができ、戦闘ラウンドの終了後には、自分を強化するためのボーナスを購入することもできる。

en.name: Defender Bros
en.description: Prepare your defenses during the day and survive until dawn. Defender Bros is a Top-Down Tower Defense Roguelike where you play as a Soldier defending your Base. Pick between multiple abilities as you level up to increase your power, then after each run buy perks and get stronger

games.name: Chronocracy
games.description: 平地でユニークな文明を築いてみよう！探検して、資源を採取して、拡大して、敵と戦おう。タイムマネジメントスキルを駆使して攻撃をかわし、謎に包まれた脅威の存在に立ち向かえ。生き残ることができる世界を築く準備はいい？

en.name: Chronocracy
en.description: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?

games.name: 夜班护士模拟器
genres: 医療シミュレーション
games.description: このサイコロジカルホラー・ナースシミュレーターで30日間を生き延びろ。日常的な医療タスクとタイムマネジメントをこなしつつ、暗い病棟に潜む恐ろしい異常存在（アノマリー）から逃れなければならない。低下していく正気度（SAN値）を管理し、給料を稼ぎ、病院の新たな「永久患者」になる前に脱出せよ。

en.name: 夜班护士模拟器
en.description: Survive 30 days in this psychological horror nursing sim. Balance routine medical tasks and time management while evading terrifying anomalies in the dark wards. Manage your dropping sanity, earn your paycheck, and escape before becoming the hospital's next permanent patient.

games.name: GANA FORCE
games.description: Gana Force は、強力な火力を放ち、巧みに弾幕を避け、地形を駆使して敵を倒す横スクロールシューティングゲームです。ゲーム環境は、エイリアンの細胞ステージ、灼熱の太陽、宇宙戦艦など多岐にわたります。強力なボスや弾幕シューティングの難関があなたを待ち受けています！

en.name: GANA FORCE
en.description: Gana Force is a Horizontal shooter where you'll unleash powerful firepower, skillfully dodge bullets, and utilize the terrain to maneuver and defeat enemies. Game environments include alien cell levels, scorching sun, space battleships, and more. Powerful bosses and bullet hell challenges await you!

games.name: 東方すくすく レーシング - Touhou Sukusuku Racing
games.shortName: 東方すくすく レーシング - TOUHOU SUKUSUKU RACING
games.description: すくすくたちよ、出発！幻想郷や異界を舞台にしたコースを駆け抜け、すくすくレースのチャンピオンを目指しましょう！『東方すくすくレーシング - Touhou Sukusuku Racing』は、かわいく、気軽に、スリルも楽しめるレースゲームです。東方Projectらしさあふれるコースを疾走し、多彩なアイテムを使ってライバルを邪魔しましょう。レースの合間には、ホームですくすくの仲間たちと遊んだり、記念写真を撮ったり。すくすくたちの幻想郷を、心ゆくまで楽しんでください！

trailers.name: 東方すくすく レーシング - Touhou Sukusuku Racing

en.name: Touhou Sukusuku Racing
en.description: Touhou Sukusuku Racing is a cute, casual racer set in Gensokyo and beyond. Speed through Touhou-inspired tracks, outplay rivals with varied items, and chase the championship. Between races, play with your Sukusuku friends at home and take photos together!

games.name: 憧れの家
games.description: 『 憧れの家』で、理想の家を作りましょう！豊富なこだわりパーツから好きなものを選び、お部屋や庭をイチからコーディネート。ゆったりとしたLo-fi BGMに耳を傾けながら、自分だけの癒やしの空間と心安らぐ時間をお楽しみください。

en.name: Tiny Dwellings
en.description: From the creators of Moonfrost, Tiny Dwellings is a whimsical hand-drawn spin-off builder with kindred pixelly vibes! Delight in designing your dream petite homesteads and charming dioramas. Unwind in a stress-free haven and dig the heartwarming lo-fi ambiences as you express your creative muse.

games.name: Under The Ghost Mountain
genres: 精密プラットフォーム
games.description: Pull on a white ritual mask and descend into Ghost Mountain in this pixel-art action platformer. Loose a crossbow bolt in midair, then slash as you land. Spend souls on a bomb now or save for homing bolts at the bonfire. Four stages stand between you and a giant clock that fires its hands.

en.name: Under The Ghost Mountain
en.description: Leap a gap, loose a crossbow bolt, then slash as you land. In this pixel-art action platformer, chaining kills earns you souls. Buy a three-bolt spread, build a foothold in midair, or pay the mountain crew to open a shortcut for future runs.

games.name: Soldiers at War
games.description: Command a squad of WWII soldiers in deep, turn-based isometric tactical combat. Pick your eight-man team from a persistent platoon, equip them with authentic historical weapons, and fight through covert missions from North Africa to Germany.

en.name: Soldiers at War
en.description: Command a squad of WWII soldiers in deep, turn-based isometric tactical combat. Pick your eight-man team from a persistent platoon, equip them with authentic historical weapons, and fight through covert missions from North Africa to Germany.

games.name: デッドバイデイライト
games.shortName: デッドバイデイライト
games.description: 恐怖に満ちた10年。ジャンプスケアに間一髪の回避、残酷な処刑に手に汗握る脱出劇…それは死と隣り合わせの10年。 不気味な悪が支配する領域に、永遠に閉じ込められた生存者たち…その死にさえ救済のない世界で、粘り強い生存者4人と血に飢えた殺人鬼1人が知恵と度胸の試される残酷なゲームに挑む。最高の非対称マルチプレイホラーゲームで生存者または殺人鬼となり、スリルと恐怖に満ちた世界を堪能しよう。

en.name: Dead by Daylight
en.description: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.

games.name: Active Matter
games.description: 崩壊した多元宇宙を舞台にした、この新しいリアルミリタリーシューターで、戦利品を求めて危険なレイドに参加したり、激しいPvPバトルに参加したりしよう。時間と空間を曲げる物質「アクティブマター」の支配権をめぐり、量子不安定ゾーンで戦え。

en.name: Active Matter
en.description: Join dangerous raids for loot or intense PvP/PvE battles in this new realistic military shooter set in a fractured multiverse. Fight in quantum-unstable zones for control of active matter - the substance that bends time and space.

games.name: Shift At Midnight
games.description: 最大3人でオンライン協力プレイを楽しめる、探偵ホラーゲーム。ランダムに生成されたシフトで力を合わせて客を調査し、誰が人間になりすましているかを突き止めよう。一つでもミスをすれば、建物に立てこもって罠を仕掛け、身を隠さなければならない。

en.name: Shift At Midnight
en.description: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.

games.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
games.description: 新たなサバイバルホラーが目覚める。『Cronos:The New Dawn』荒廃した未来の世界を生き延び、悪夢のように融合するクリーチャーと戦い、人類を滅ぼした黙示録の真相を探るため、時を遡って魂を狩れ。

en.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
en.description: A whole new breed of survival horror emerges with Cronos: The New Dawn. Survive the brutal wastelands of the future, fight nightmarish merging creatures and jump back in time to harvest souls as you seek to uncover the origins of the apocalypse that wiped out humanity.

games.name: 零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE
games.description: 今度こそ離さない―― 妖しく羽化する、美しき恐怖。

trailers.name: 『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』ローンチトレーラー
『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』ゲーム紹介トレーラー
『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』発売日告知トレーラー

en.name: FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE
en.description: Together, always.

games.name: Escape from Playtime
games.description: 廃墟と化したおもちゃ工場に閉じ込められたあなたと仲間たちが繰り広げる、1～4人向けオンライン協力型ホラーゲーム。目的を明かさぬ謎の声に従って変化し続ける道を探索し、道具を探しながら闇に潜むクリーチャーと生き残りをかけて戦おう。

trailers.name: Release Date Trailer - Escape from Playtime
Everything You Need To Know - Escape From Playtime

en.name: Escape from Playtime
en.description: An online 2-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

games.name: REANIMAL
games.description: Little Nightmares™ I & IIのクリエイターからお届けするダークで恐ろしい冒険。このホラー・アドベンチャーゲームは、ある兄弟が行方不明の友達を助け、故郷の島から逃げ出す物語を描いています。

en.name: REANIMAL
en.description: The creators of Little Nightmares™ I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

games.name: YAPYAP
games.description: YapYapとは、魔導師となり、ライバルの塔を荒らすために最大5人の友だちを手下として召喚する魔法協力型ホラーゲームだ。様々な呪文を唱え、塔を守る魔獣やモンスターを避けつつ破壊目標を達成せよ。

en.name: YAPYAP
en.description: A magic-themed co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends are minions summoned by a wizard to break into their rival's towers to cause mayhem. Try to fufill your vandalism target with an assortment of spells while avoiding magical beasts and monsters that protect the tower.

games.name: Halloween: The Game
games.description: 1978年のハロウィンの夜、誰もマイケル・マイヤーズから逃れることはできない。『ハロウィン』でブギーマンになるか、悪の化身に立ち向かうかはあなた次第だ。

en.name: Halloween: The Game
en.description: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

games.name: GONE Fishing
games.description: GONE Fishing は、1〜8人で遊べるサバイバルホラーです。仲間と力を合わせ、釣りで生き延びましょう。生き残る唯一の方法は、湖の底なしの飢えを満たし続けること。さもなければ、喰われるのはあなたです。 あなたはその飢えを満たせるか……それとも、次の生贄になるか？

en.name: GONE Fishing
en.description: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

games.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER
games.description: 『DON’T SCREAM TOGETHER』は、1993年の真っ暗な森を仲間とカメラ片手に歩くオンライン協力型ホラーシミュレーターです。近距離ボイスチャットで協力して脱出を目指そう。ただし誰かが叫ぶとゲームがリスタート、またはハンターとして復活します！

trailers.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER Announcement Teaser Trailer

en.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER
en.description: A very simple co-op jumpscare horror experience where you and friends walk through a pitch black forest and try to stay quiet. Reach 8:00 AM without screaming or making a loud noise, or everyone dies. You will scream, shout, and probably laugh.

games.name: 井戸の鳥 (Well Dweller)
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
games.description: 『Well Dweller』は崩壊した王国で暮らす、魅力的なキャラクターが多数登場するダークなおとぎ話風のメトロイドヴァニアです。マッチ棒で武装した小さな鳥、グリマーとなって、家族を救うために邪悪な女王を焼き尽くそう。

en.name: Well Dweller
en.description: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

games.name: Chernobylite Complete Edition
games.description: 「Chernobylite」はデベロッパー「The Farm 51」による、SFサバイバルホラーRPGゲームです。荒廃したチェルノブイリの立入禁止区域を3Dスキャンして創り上げられた超リアルなワールドが舞台となります。いくつもの分岐を含むストーリーに飛び込み、真実を解き明かそう。

en.name: Chernobylite Complete Edition
en.description: Chernobylite is a science-fiction survival horror RPG. Set in the hyper-realistic, 3D-scanned wasteland of Chernobyl’s Exclusion Zone, explore a non-linear storyline in your search to uncover the truth of your tortured past.

games.name: Trepang2
games.description: 筋金入りのワルになれ。FPS『Trepang2』は、遠い未来を舞台に繰り広げる血なまぐさいアクション満載のFPSゲーム。ハードコアかつ熱狂的なシューティングで敵を完膚なきまでに叩きのめし、銃弾を回避し、破壊の爪痕を残していこう。

en.name: Trepang2
en.description: Become the ultimate badass in Trepang2: A gory, action-packed FPS set in the near future. Unleash all hell on your enemies, dodge bullets and leave a trail of destruction in this hardcore and frenetic shooter.

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.description: 最大4人の協力プレイで探検家として徒党を組み、財宝を探し求めよう。この呪われし密林にはそこかしこに危険が潜み、モンスターたちが現実を塗り替える。狂気に抗い密林を制覇しなければ、己自身が密林に貪られてしまうのだ…

en.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
en.description: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: Dead Space™ 2
genres: サードパーソンシューティング
games.description: ネクロモーフがUSGイシムラに蔓延してから3年後、スプロールと呼ばれる宇宙ステーションで、昏睡状態だったアイザック・クラークはもうろうと混濁した意識のなか目覚める。新しい世界と無重力環境を探索して、ユニトロジーの真実とネクロモーフの蔓延の理由を突き止めよう。

en.name: Dead Space™ 2
en.description: Three years after the Necromorph infestation aboard the USS Ishimura, Isaac Clarke awakens from a coma, confused, disoriented, and on a space station called The Sprawl. Explore this world and its zero-g environments to discover the truth about the Unitology and its role in the Necromorph epidemic.

games.name: Dead Space™ 3
games.description: ともに恐怖を乗り越えろ

en.name: Dead Space™ 3
en.description: Journey across space to the icy planet of Tau Volantis with Isaac Clarke and Sgt. John Carver to discover and destroy the source of the Necromorph outbreak.

games.name: Oh Deer
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
games.description: ハンター1人、最大4人の友達がシカに変装しています。 このスリリングなかくれんぼゲームでは、すべての動きが最後かもしれません。 あなたは群れに紛れるか、目立ちますか？ オー、シカ...

en.name: Oh Deer
en.description: One hunter & up to 9 friends disguised as deer. A game of hide-and-seek where every move could be your last. Will you blend in with the herd or stand out? Oh Deer...

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.shortName: INTO THE DEAD: OUR DARKEST DAYS
games.description: 1980年、テキサス州の街ウォルトンはゾンビで溢れかえっていた。窮地に立たされた生存者となり、物資を集めて装備を整え、安全なシェルターを探して過酷なサバイバルを乗り越えろ。慎重に計画を立て、力を合わせ、決して立ち止まってはならない——この地獄から生還したいのなら。

en.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
en.description: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: クアリー～悪夢のサマーキャンプ
games.shortName: クアリー～悪夢のサマーキャンプ
games.description: サマーキャンプ最後の日、キャンプカウンセラーを務めていた9人の若者たちは、先の読めない恐怖の一夜を体験することになります。血生臭いハンターたちと彼らをつけ狙う謎の怪物。しかし、それ以上に恐ろしいのは、生き延びるために若者たちが下さなければならない決断なのです。

trailers.name: The Quarry - Accolades - EN No Rating
The Quarry - Launch Day - EN No Rating
The Quarry - Gameplay Overview - EN No Rating

en.name: The Quarry
en.description: When the sun goes down on the last night of summer camp, nine teenage counselors are plunged into an unpredictable night of horror. The only thing worse than the blood-drenched locals and creatures hunting them are the unimaginable choices you must make to help them survive.

games.name: ドットホラーストーリー (DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition)
games.shortName: ドットホラーストーリー (DISTRAINT: DELUXE EDITION)
games.description: ドットホラーストーリーはパソコン用2D心理ホラーアドベンチャーゲーム。有名企業と手を組むためにプライスは年老いた女性の財産を奪う。まさにその瞬間、彼は自分の人間性の代償を知る。

en.name: DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition
en.description: DISTRAINT is a 2D psychological horror adventure game for PC. In order to secure a partnership in a famous company, Price seizes the property of an elderly woman. In that very moment, he finds out the price of his humanity.

games.name: The Headliners
games.description: 協力型ホラーゲームで、1～8人のジャーナリストチームとなり、致命的なクリーチャーに侵略されたニューヨークを探索し、壮大な写真を撮影します。あなたの唯一の目標は、見出しを飾ること...そして、生きてそれを読むことです。

en.name: The Headliners
en.description: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 8 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

games.name: Dark Hours
games.description: 『Dark Hours』は、1～4人でプレイする協力型サバイバルホラーゲーム。あなたは超自然的な出来事に強盗の邪魔をされ、チームメイトは邪悪な存在に捕らえられてしまう。計画のことは忘れて、生き残ることが先決だ。出口を見つけために、仲間と協力して探索しよう。

en.name: Dark Hours
en.description: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out.

games.name: Visage
games.description: Visage は一人称視点の心理ホラーゲームです。 薄気味悪い慰めと恐ろしいほど現実的な環境が混在する独特の雰囲気のある世界の中、ゆっくりとしたペースで進行します。怪しく、姿を変え続ける家を探索し、真の恐怖をご体験ください。

en.name: Visage
en.description: Visage is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world that combines both uncannily comforting and horrifyingly realistic environments, and enjoy a genuinely terrifying experience.

games.name: Barotrauma
games.description: 『Barotrauma』は、宇宙サバイバルホラー・潜水艦シュミレーターにRPG要素を加えたの2D協力ゲームです。潜水艦を操作して、ミッションをクリアし、モンスターと戦い、リークを修復して、機械を操作して、銃を使い、アイテムをクラフトします。油断は禁物です：ここでは危険の通知というものが存在しません！

en.name: Barotrauma
en.description: Barotrauma is a 2D co-op submarine simulator – in space, with survival horror and RPG elements. Steer your submarine, complete missions, fight monsters, fix leaks, operate machinery, man the guns and craft items, and stay alert: danger in Barotrauma doesn’t announce itself!

games.name: White Knuckle
games.description: 『White Knuckle』は、一人称視点のローグライト・スピードクライミングゲーム。精密な移動テクニックを駆使し、サブストラクチャー17の内部を登り抜けろ。鋭い反射神経とリソース管理で、朽ちたコンクリートに埋もれた地下1万メートルの底から這い上がれ。

en.name: White Knuckle
en.description: White Knuckle is a first-person roguelite speed-climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will bring you out from under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

games.name: Demonologist
games.description: Demonologistは、最低1人、最大4人で遊べるCo-Opホラーゲームです。呪われた場所にいる悪霊の種類を特定し、装備を駆使して悪霊を祓うことが目的です、一人でもチームでも楽しめます。

en.name: Demonologist
en.description: Demonologist is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. Your goal is to identify the type of evil spirit in cursed places and exorcise it using your equipment, either alone or with your team.

games.name: BIOHAZARD 3 LAST ESCAPE (1999)
games.description: あの忌まわしい洋館事件の生存者である「ジル・バレンタイン」を操り、悪夢の続きを目撃せよ。S.T.A.R.S.を辞め、ラクーンシティからの脱出を目論む彼女を待っていたのは、新たな困難だった。人間を捕食するゾンビで溢れた街から生きて逃げ出すには、知恵と力を最大限に振り絞らなければならない。

en.name: Resident Evil 3 Nemesis (1999)
en.description: Join Jill Valentine, the survivor of the notorious disaster, as her nightmare continues. After resigning from S.T.A.R.S. Jill now prepares to head out of Raccoon City… but caught in a town crawling with zombies, more than ever she must rely on brute force and cunning to find a way to escape alive.

games.name: 魔女の家MV
games.description: 少女ヴィオラは、森の中にたたずむ謎めいた館へと容赦なく引き寄せられている。そこは痛みと混乱、そして死の場所である。その憎むべき闇と忌まわしい過去を調べよ。君の行く手を阻む謎を解け。そして魔女の家の地獄のような空間から逃げ出そう。

en.name: The Witch's House MV
en.description: A young girl, Viola, is drawn inexorably to a mysterious manor that seems to change behind her back. It is a place of pain, turmoil and death. Plumb its detestable depths and abominable history. Untangle riddles that bar your perilous path. And flee the hellish halls of The Witch’s House.

games.name: Species: Unknown
games.description: Species: Unknownは1～4人協力プレイ対応のサバイバルホラーです。廃墟となった船で未知の生物に追われながら、危険なミッションを遂行しましょう。生き残り、装備を強化して暗闇に潜む新たな恐怖に立ち向かいましょう。

en.name: Species: Unknown
en.description: Species: Unknown is a 1 to 4 players co-op survival horror. Complete high-risk missions aboard an abandoned ship while being hunted by an unknown creature. Survive and upgrade your gear to face each new threat that lurks in the dark.

games.name: The Evil Within
games.description: Developed by Shinji Mikami -- creator of the seminal Resident Evil series -- and the talented team at Tango Gameworks, The Evil Within embodies the meaning of pure survival horror. Highly-crafted environments, horrifying anxiety, and an intricate story are combined to create an immersive world that will bring you to the height of tension. With limited resources at your disposal, you’ll fight for survival and experience profound fear in this perfect blend of horror and action.

en.name: The Evil Within
en.description: Developed by Shinji Mikami -- creator of the seminal Resident Evil series -- and the talented team at Tango Gameworks, The Evil Within embodies the meaning of pure survival horror. Highly-crafted environments, horrifying anxiety, and an intricate story are combined to create an immersive world that will bring you to the height of tension. With limited resources at your disposal, you’ll fight for survival and experience profound fear in this perfect blend of horror and action.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
games.shortName: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: SECURITY BREACH
games.description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breachでは、フレディ・ファズベアのメガ・ピザプレックスに閉じ込められた少年、グレゴリーとなりプレイしてください。フレディ・ファズベア本人の助けを借りながら、グレゴリーはピザプレックスの秘密を明らかにし、真実を追及しながら夜明けまで生き残らなければなりません。

trailers.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach Launch Trailer

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
en.description: In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach, play as Gregory, a young boy who’s been trapped overnight inside of Freddy Fazbear’s Mega Pizzaplex. With the help of Freddy himself, Gregory must uncover the secrets of the Pizzaplex, learn the truth, and survive until dawn.

games.name: 恐怖の世界
games.description: 怪異とのバトル、そして容赦のない選択肢が紡ぎ出す、地獄のようなローグライトRPG。本作は、伊藤潤二氏とH.P. Lovecraft氏へ捧げる1ビットのラブレターである。プレイするたび変化する悪夢のような出会いが、不可解な事件を解き明かすカギとなる。謎の先に待つものは…

en.name: WORLD OF HORROR
en.description: Experience the quiet terror of this 1-bit love letter to Junji Ito and H.P. Lovecraft. Navigate a hellish roguelite reality with turn-based combat and unforgiving choices. Experiment with your deck of event cards to discover new forms of cosmic horror in every playthrough. The inevitable awaits...

games.name: Quake 4
games.description: "プレイヤーはエリート部隊Rhino Squadの一員として、敵エイリアンの母星へ進攻する地球軍のために先陣を切らなければならない。しかし、人類の存亡をかけた絶望的な戦争で、容赦ない敵に立ち向かうための方法があるとすれば… それは彼らの一人になるということなのかもしれない。 ※本製品では日本語はサポートされていません"

en.name: Quake 4
en.description: As part of the elite Rhino Squad, you must spearhead Earth’s military invasion of a hostile alien homeworld. But, in this desperate war for humanity’s survival against an unrelenting enemy, you may discover that the only way to defeat them...is to become one of them.

games.name: Labyrinthine
games.description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

en.name: Labyrinthine
en.description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

games.name: Scanner Sombre
games.description: Scanner Sombreは、暗闇が最大の敵となる3Dホラー洞窟探検ゲームです。LIDAR スキャナーで目に見えないものを照らし、深淵の不気味な美しさと危険を明らかにしよう。プリズンアーキテクトのクリエイターが贈るこの没入型アドベンチャーは、光と影を駆使して呪われた体験をもたらします。

en.name: Scanner Sombre
en.description: Scanner Sombre is a 3d horror cave exploration game where darkness is your greatest foe. Illuminate the unseen with your LIDAR scanner, revealing the eerie beauty and peril of the abyss. From the creators of Prison Architect, this immersive adventure uses light and shadow for a haunting experience.

games.name: Prey
genres: 没入シミュレーション
games.description: In Prey, you awaken aboard Talos I, a space station orbiting the moon in the year 2032. You are the key subject of an experiment meant to alter humanity forever – but things have gone terribly wrong. The space station has been overrun by hostile aliens and you are now being hunted. As you dig into the dark secrets of Talos I and your own past, you must survive using the tools found on the station, your wits, weapons, and mind-bending abilities.

en.name: Prey
en.description: In Prey, you awaken aboard Talos I, a space station orbiting the moon in the year 2032. You are the key subject of an experiment meant to alter humanity forever – but things have gone terribly wrong. The space station has been overrun by hostile aliens and you are now being hunted. As you dig into the dark secrets of Talos I and your own past, you must survive using the tools found on the station, your wits, weapons, and mind-bending abilities.

games.name: Alice: Madness Returns
games.description: アリスはワンダーランドと自分自身を救えるだろうか － その両方を侵食する狂気から。

en.name: Alice: Madness Returns
en.description: Alice: Madness Returns is a third-person, single-player, action adventure platformer. Visit the grim reality of Victorian London and travel to the beautiful yet ghastly Wonderland to uncover the root of Alice's madness.

games.name: We Were Here Too
games.description: 最期の時が近づき、はるか遠く、激しい嵐の中にそびえる巨大な城。コミュニケーションを活用するcoopアドベンチャーで城に潜む闇の真実を暴き出そう。

trailers.name: We Were Here - Too  | Official Release Trailer
We Were Here - Too | Official Gameplay Trailer
We Were Here - Too | Official Trailer

en.name: We Were Here Too
en.description: As your final hour approaches, a large structure looms up in the distance, towering above the relentless storm. Discover the truth behind this dark castle in a communication-based, cooperative puzzle adventure.

games.name: Darkwood ダークウッド
games.description: 新感覚サバイバルホラーゲーム『ダークウッド』。昼は自由に世界を探索し、夜は隠れ家に身を潜めて夜明けを祈れ。

en.name: Darkwood
en.description: Darkwood - a new perspective on survival horror. Scavenge and explore a rich, ever-changing free-roam world by day, then hunker down in your hideout and pray for the morning light.

games.name: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: HELP WANTED
games.shortName: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: HELP WANTED
games.description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted is a collection of classic and original mini-games set in the Five Nights universe. Experience the horror in flat (non-VR) mode or VR. Oculus Rift and HTC Vive are supported. A VR Headset is NOT required to play.

en.name: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: HELP WANTED
en.description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted is a collection of classic and original mini-games set in the Five Nights universe. Experience the horror in flat (non-VR) mode or VR. Oculus Rift and HTC Vive are supported. A VR Headset is NOT required to play.

games.name: biohazard 0 HD REMASTER
games.description: シリーズ累計販売本数6,500万本を超える『バイオハザード』シリーズ。 その出発点である「洋館事件」の始まりが描かれた作品「biohazard 0」をHDリマスター化。 秘められた恐怖と謎を、あなた自身で体験してもらいたい。 【イーライセンス利用許諾番号】ID34094

en.name: Resident Evil 0
en.description: Before the mansion, before the destruction of Raccoon City, there was Resident Evil 0. Now remastered with improved visuals and sounds, as well as the all-new Wesker Mode, there's never been a better time to experience the origins of the Resident Evil story.

games.name: ZOMBI
games.description: ロンドンはもう終わりだ。人類は絶滅の危機に陥っていた。伝染病にかかった人々を待ち受けるのは死よりも恐ろしい結末だった。次々と襲いかかる大群に立ち向かう勇気は? ZOMBI（ゾンビ）は恐怖のサバイバルホラーアクションゲーム。人間としていつまで生き残ることができるのだろうか?

en.name: ZOMBI
en.description: London is falling. Are you prepared? The Last Blight is upon us. It was foretold. For the second time in history, a great plague has shrouded London in a fog of death. Big Ben tolls as thousands of unprepared die, or worse, are infected by a sickness more gruesome than death.

games.name: The Past Within
games.description: 『The Past Within』は、ラスティレイクがお届けする新しい協力プレイ体験です！信頼できる誰かと一緒にプレイしましょう。それぞれが過去と未来でプレイすることになります。周りをよく観察して、見たものを相手に伝えましょう。パズルを解いて、アルバート・ヴァンダーブームの策略を明らかにしてください。

trailers.name: The Past Within - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

en.name: The Past Within
en.description: The Past Within is the new co-op experience from Rusty Lake! Play together with someone you deem trustworthy: one in The Past, the other in The Future. Observe and communicate what you see around you. Solve the puzzles and uncover Albert Vanderboom’s plan.

games.name: メトロ2033 リダックス
games.shortName: メトロ2033 リダックス
games.description: 2013年、世界は終末的な出来事により荒廃した。ほぼ全ての人類は消滅し、地球の地面は有毒な焦土と化してしまった。わずかな生存者たちはモスクワの地下深くへと逃げのび、人類の文明は新たな”闇の時代”へと突入した。時は2033年。

en.name: METRO 2033 Redux
en.description: In 2013 the world was devastated by an apocalyptic event, annihilating almost all mankind and turning the Earth's surface into a poisonous wasteland. A handful of survivors took refuge in the depths of the Moscow underground, and human civilization entered a new Dark Age. The year is 2033.

games.name: メトロ ラストライト リダックス
games.shortName: メトロ ラストライト リダックス
games.description: 時は2034年。終末のモスクワの廃墟、その地下にある地下鉄のトンネルでは、人類の生き残りが外側 – そして内側から恐るべき脅威にさらされている。ミュータントたちが地下では墓地をうろつき、荒廃した地表では毒に侵された空の下狩りをしている。

en.name: METRO Last Light Redux
en.description: It is the year 2034. Beneath the ruins of post-apocalyptic Moscow, in the tunnels of the Metro, the remnants of mankind are besieged by deadly threats from outside – and within. Mutants stalk the catacombs beneath the desolate surface, and hunt amidst the poisoned skies above.

games.name: Emissary Zero
games.description: 協力型ホラー (1～4 人用)。夜に謎の建物を探索するよう命じられます。月を見つけて、生きて帰れるように努力しましょう。

en.name: Emissary Zero
en.description: Co-op horror (1-4 players). You are sent to explore a mysterious building at night. Find the Moon and try to return alive.

games.name: Layers of Fear (2016)
games.description: 雰囲気作りとシナリオに重きを置いた一人称サイコホラー。自らの人間性を犠牲にしてでも傑作を完成させようとする画家として、変わりゆくビクトリア朝の洋館を探索せよ。

en.name: Layers of Fear (2016)
en.description: A first-person psychological horror with a strong emphasis on atmosphere and storytelling. Explore an ever-shifting Victorian mansion as a painter seeking to complete his masterpiece, even at the cost of his own sanity.

games.name: Fears to Fathom - Ironbark Lookout
games.description: ジャックネルソンは、24歳の火の見張り員で、新しい見張り所に異動しました。新しい家に落ち着いていく中で、何かがおかしいという感覚を振り払うことができませんでした。彼はまだ知らなかったが、アイアンバーク州立公園で何が起こっているのか。

en.name: Fears to Fathom - Ironbark Lookout
en.description: Jack Nelson, a 24-year-old fire lookout, transferred to a new outpost. As he settled into his new home, he couldn't shake the feeling that something was off, little did he know what was transpiring down in Ironbark State Park.

games.name: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead
games.shortName: A QUIET PLACE: THE ROAD AHEAD
games.description: 『A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead』は、大ヒット映画シリーズを原作とするシングルプレイホラーアドベンチャーゲーム。静寂の中を生き残れ。

trailers.name: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead – Survive in Silence
A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead – Launch Trailer

en.name: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead
en.description: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead is a single-player horror adventure game inspired by the critically acclaimed blockbuster movie franchise. Survive in silence.

games.name: Zort
games.description: Zortは、最大4人で遊べるアクション、アドベンチャー、ホラーゲームです。友達と一緒にマップを探索し、さまざまなクリーチャーから逃げながら楽しんでください。ゲーム内のボイスチャットを使用して、友達とリアルなホラー体験を楽しんでください!

en.name: Zort
en.description: Zort is an action, adventure, and horror game that can be played with up to 4 people. Explore maps with your friends and have fun while escaping from various creatures. Experience a realistic horror experience with in-game voice chat with your friends!

games.name: Pacify
games.description: PAH社のために超自然的な生物を鎮め、弱体化させ、捕獲するオンライン協力型ホラーゲームです。各ステージには異なるストーリー、ユニークなモンスター、そして複数のエンディングが用意されています。シングルプレイはもちろん、最大6人の友達と一緒にプレイすることも可能です。楽しいエフェクト付きの近接ボイスチャット機能も搭載されています。

trailers.name: Pacify - New Scary Horror Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Pacify
en.description: An online co-op horror game where you pacify, weaken and capture supernatural creatures for PAH Inc. Each level has a different story, unique monsters, and multiple endings. Play single player or together with up to 6 friends. Includes proximity voice chat with fun effects.

games.name: Witch Hunt
games.description: Witch Huntは、18世紀を舞台にしたホラーテーマのハンティングゲーム。ゲームの主な特徴として、探索、ノンリニア性、そして雰囲気を重視しています。

en.name: Witch Hunt
en.description: Witch Hunt is a challenging horror themed hunting game that takes place in the 18th century. Main focus of the game is on exploration, non-linearity, and atmosphere.

games.name: 殺戮の天使
games.description: 「お願い、私を殺して」「一緒にここから出る手助けをしてくれよ。そしたらお前を、殺してやるよ」 『殺戮の天使』はエピソード1からエピソード4の4部構成からなるサイコホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。

en.name: Angels of Death
en.description: "Please... kill me." "Help me get outta here, and I'll kill you." ~ Angels of Death is a psychological horror-adventure game, consisting of four episodes.

games.name: Pathologic 3
games.description: In this psychological horror game, you are a doctor with only 12 days to save a town from a mysterious plague. Make ruthless decisions and diagnose with precision. Shape the town's future and rewrite the past. Hold yourself together while it all falls apart.

en.name: Pathologic 3
en.description: In this psychological horror game, you are a doctor with only 12 days to save a town from a mysterious plague. Make ruthless decisions and diagnose with precision. Shape the town's future and rewrite the past. Hold yourself together while it all falls apart.

games.name: [Chilla's Art] The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件
games.description: 夜勤事件は、コンビニの夜勤で働く女子大生に関するJホラーゲームです。

en.name: [Chilla's Art] The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件
en.description: The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件 is a J-horror game about a college girl on a night shift.

games.name: DOOM 3
games.description: "デーモンの侵攻により、火星の「ユニオンエアロスペースコーポレーション（UAC）」研究施設が蹂躙された。数少ない生存者の1人として地獄を突き進み、デーモンの軍勢と死闘を繰り広げよ。数々の賞を受賞したホラー/アクション満載のファーストパーソン・シューティングのオリジナル版『DOOM』がリマスターとなって登場。 ※本製品では日本語はサポートされていません"

en.name: DOOM 3
en.description: A demonic invasion has overwhelmed the Union Aerospace Corporation's Mars research facility. As one of only a few survivors, you must fight your way to hell and back against a horde of demons in this award-winning horror/action FPS and reimagining of the original DOOM.

games.name: Look Outside
games.description: これは、アパートの一室から始まるサバイバルホラーRPG。謎だらけの出来事によって、窓の外を見た者はグロテスクな化け物へと姿を変えられ、世界を本物の混沌へと陥れる。建物の中を調べ回って食糧、物資、武器を探し出せ。そして奇妙な者たちと出会うことになるだろう。

en.name: Look Outside
en.description: Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
games.description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it's your job to keep an eye on them!

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
en.description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it's your job to keep an eye on them!

games.name: Murky Divers
games.description: ソロまたは最大8人のプレイヤー。放棄された水中研究所から、雇い主の失敗した実験の痕跡を消去しなければならない。潜水艦を操縦し、深淵の恐ろしいものを避けつつ、全ての死体を排除しよう。

en.name: Murky Divers
en.description: Solo or up to 8 players. Get rid of your employer's failed experiments in abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, avoid abyssal terrors, and remove all corpses.

games.name: Home Sweet Home
games.description: Home Sweet Home is a first-person horror adventure game based on Thai myths and beliefs. The core gameplay focuses on storytelling and stealth to avoid perilous spirits hunting you. Moreover, few puzzles are added into the game, making gameplay more various. While playing this game, you will be thrilled by a horror Thai atmosphere, unpredictable scary moments and challenging gameplay!

en.name: Home Sweet Home
en.description: Home Sweet Home is a first-person horror adventure game based on Thai myths and beliefs. The core gameplay focuses on storytelling and stealth to avoid perilous spirits hunting you. Moreover, few puzzles are added into the game, making gameplay more various. While playing this game, you will be thrilled by a horror Thai atmosphere, unpredictable scary moments and challenging gameplay!

games.name: At Dead Of Night
games.description: At Dead Of Night is part horror film, part horror game and part ghost hunt. It blends live-action and graphics to create a unique immersive horror experience like no other.

en.name: At Dead Of Night
en.description: At Dead Of Night is part horror film, part horror game and part ghost hunt. It blends live-action and graphics to create a unique immersive horror experience like no other.

games.name: PANICORE (パニコアー)
games.description: PANICOREは、パーマデス、AIモンスター、協力プレイをミックスしたサバイバルホラーゲームだ。捕まらないように脱出を試みるが、注意：彼らはあなたの足音だけでなく、声も聞いている。

en.name: PANICORE
en.description: PANICORE is a survival horror game that mixes permadeath, AI monsters and a co-op experience up to 5 players (4 players in demo). Try to escape and don't get caught, but beware: they don't only hear your steps, but also your voice.

games.name: Hello Neighbor
games.description: Hello Neighborは、隣人の家の地下室にこっそり侵入して、家主がどんな秘密を隠しているのかを探り当てるステルスホラーゲームです。あなたの一挙手一投足から学習する高度なAIを相手にプレイします。窓をよじ登って家に潜入するのが好きですか？ベアトラップも仕掛けられています。エスケープ？AIが近道を見つけてあなたを捕らえようとします。

en.name: Hello Neighbor
en.description: Hello Neighbor is a Stealth Horror Game about sneaking into your neighbor's house and figuring out what he's hiding in the basement. Play against an advanced AI that learns from your actions.

games.name: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
games.description: The stage is set. Imagine an old baroque manor, perhaps a hotel or a museum, somewhere in central Europe. A woman wanders in search of answers.

Lorelei and the Laser Eyes | Maze Trailer

games.name: BIOHAZARD 2 (1998)
games.description: はじめての任務に向かう途中で大事件に巻き込まれた新人警官の「レオン・Ｓ・ケネディ」と、音信不通となった兄を捜す「クレア・レッドフィールド」の物語が個別に展開。最新の3Dアクセラレーテッドグラフィックスが、リアルな恐怖体験を呼び起こす。

en.name: Resident Evil 2 (1998)
en.description: Command Leon S. Kennedy, a rookie cop who stumbles onto the carnage reporting for his first duty, or play as Claire Redfield, desperately searching for her missing brother. Cutting edge 3-D accelerated graphics that create a terrifying, photo-realistic experience.

games.name: Nine-Ball Roulette
games.description: これは、あなたが今までプレイした中で最もスリリングなビリヤードゲームになります。友達を最大3人参加させ、このエキサイティングなプールルーレットゲームに挑もう！最後の一人になるまでプールで相手を排除してください。

en.name: Nine-Ball Roulette
en.description: This will be the most thrilling pool game you have ever played. Join up to 3 of your friends in this exciting pool roulette game! Eliminate each other with pool until only one person is left.

games.name: MOLE
games.description: 戦後に生まれた超巨大掘削艇「モール」を操縦し、潜るはスラヴの地の底。機能不全に陥るシステムを修理し、死者の声に耳を澄まし、そして自らの無事を祈れ──この棺には、“何か”がいる…… 先にコワれるのは機体か、精神か。

en.name: MOLE
en.description: Pilot the MOLE, a monstrous post-war drilling machine built to descend deep below the Slavic soil. Fix failing systems, follow voices of the dead, and pray you can survive whatever is sharing your coffin. Will the vessel or your mind break first?

games.name: That's not my Neighbor
games.description: 1955年、何らかの理由でドッペルゲンガーが通常より多く見られるようになっています。そのため、ドッペルゲンガー検出局（D.D.D.）が対策を講じました。 あなたはアパートの管理人で、自分の隣人だと主張する人を通すかどうかを判断する必要があります。

en.name: That's not my Neighbor
en.description: It's 1955, and for unknown reasons, doppelgangers are more common than usual. Therefore, the Department of Doppelganger Detection (D.D.D.) has taken action. You are the doorman of an apartment complex, and you must decide whether to let in those who claim to be your neighbors.

games.name: The Mortuary Assistant
games.description: 隣り合わせの死…。遺体をエンバームして悪霊を追い払い、自身の魂を守れ。

en.name: The Mortuary Assistant
en.description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

games.name: うみねこのなく頃に
games.description: 【うみねこのなく頃に】本作品は日本語モード、英語モードを搭載したサウンドノベルです。物語の前編となるＥＰ１～４が収録されています。

en.name: Umineko When They Cry - Question Arcs
en.description: Umineko When They Cry is the 2nd series of Sound Novel released by 07th Expansion. The steam version features renewed character sprites which is swappable from the classic art.

games.name: DON'T SCREAM
games.description: 叫んだら即終了。2人の作者により、Unreal Engine 5を駆使して開発された短編ホラゲー。クリア条件は、なんと「叫ばずに18分間森を探索する」…だけ？と思いきや、「時間が経過するのは移動中のみ」という特別ルールあり。お友達やご家族を徹底的にビビらせたい方は必見！プレイにはマイクが必須です！

en.name: DON'T SCREAM
en.description: If you scream, you restart. A jumpscare horror simulator where you walk through a pitch black forest and escape by reaching 8:00 AM.

games.name: 人喰ノ檻 - KLETKA
games.description: KLETKA(クレトカ)は、君たち囚人を捕食しようとするエレベーターに乗って、地下深くへ降りていく協力型ホラーゲームだ。エレベーターに食べられないよう餌を与え、トラップやモンスターを避け、地下深くまで降りていこう。

en.name: KLETKA
en.description: KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

games.name: Subliminal
games.description: 『Subliminal』は、都市伝説「バックルーム」から着想を得た一人称視点のパズルゲームです。写実的なグラフィック、超現実的なシーン設計、豊富なステージでの謎解き、そして独特なストーリーが特徴。主人公は超現実的でバックルームのような世界に広がる記憶の断片に閉じ込められ、暗闇と恐怖に一人で立ち向かいながら、様々なパズルや追跡に挑んでいくことになります…

en.name: Subliminal
en.description: Subliminal is a psychological horror game inspired by the urban legend of The Backrooms. Bleeding edge lighting and rendering, handcrafted open-ended levels, light and perspective-based puzzles, nostalgic spaces, unfamiliar faces, and a rotting feeling that something is not quite right.

games.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
games.description: 自分の体験と『Fears to Fathom』のあるエピソードの間にある背筋が凍るような類似点に気づいたテッサとマーカスは、自分たちのエピソードを共有することにした。『Scratch Creek』は、オンライン限定の協力プレイ専用タイトルだ。

en.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
en.description: After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of Fears to Fathom, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience. Scratch Creek is an exclusively online co-op experience.

en.description: Are you ready to serve the guests in the Rusty Lake Hotel? Solve all mysteries in this dark and eerie puzzle game. Rusty Lake Hotel is a point-and-click adventure by the creators of the Rusty Lake & Cube Escape series.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2

en.name: F.E.A.R. 3
en.description: F.E.A.R. 3 delivers all the hallmarks that define the F.E.A.R. brand: terrifying paranormal experience, frenetic combat and a dramatic storyline.

games.name: >observer_
games.description: 崩れ行くネオンカラーの未来世界を舞台にした元祖一人称サイバーパンク・ホラー・サスペンス。手がかりを求めて他人の意識に入り込むオブザーバーとして、プレイヤーは壊れた腐敗した人の記憶を辿る。謎に包まれたの殺人犯を追いながら、自らの暗い過去と向き合え。

en.name: >observer_
en.description: The original first‑person cyberpunk horror detective tale set in a decaying, neon‑scarred future. As an Observer who invades minds to hunt for clues, you will sift through corrupted memories to track down a mysterious killer and confront your own dark past.

games.name: ドットホラーストーリー２ (DISTRAINT 2)
games.shortName: ドットホラーストーリー２ (DISTRAINT 2)
games.description: 君はプライス。自らの人間性を売って大手企業 (マクデード、ブルトン&ムーア) との提携を勝ち取った男だ。 ドットホラーストーリー２は最初のゲームの出来事からの続きです。希望を取り戻し、自分の目的を見つける不幸な物語。

en.name: DISTRAINT 2
en.description: You are Price, a man who sold his humanity to get a partnership from a leading company: McDade, Bruton & Moore. DISTRAINT 2 follows on from the events of the first game. It's a sinister tale about restoring hope and finding your purpose.

games.name: CONSCRIPT: Director’s Cut
games.description: 時は第一次世界大戦。一人のフランス兵が曲がりくねった塹壕を突き進み、限られた物資をかき集め、複雑なパズルを解きながら、人類史上最も残虐で恐ろしい戦闘からの生還をかけて戦う。『CONSCRIPT』は昔ながらのサバイバルホラーを新たに解釈したゲームだ。

en.name: CONSCRIPT: Director’s Cut
en.description: During the First World War, a lone French soldier must navigate twisted trenches, scavenge for limited supplies and solve complex puzzles—all whilst fighting for survival in the midst of mankind’s most brutal and horrifying conflict. CONSCRIPT is a new historical take on classic survival horror.

games.name: Fears to Fathom - Woodbury Getaway
games.description: コンサルティング会社に勤務する23歳のシドニー・ハーパーは、大学の友人たちと共にウッドベリーのレンタルハウスで週末を過ごす計画を立てた。そこで何が起きるとも知らずに...

en.name: Fears to Fathom - Woodbury Getaway
en.description: Sydney Harper, a 23-year-old working at a consulting firm plans a weekend getaway to a Woodbury rental with her college friends. Little did she know what was about to unfold during their stay.

games.name: Detention
games.description: 1960年代の台湾、架空世界の学校を舞台にしたホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。台湾ならではの文化を表現したいため、キャラクターやシーンも台湾人に親しみのある要素を採用しており、一膳飯、廟宇、神壇など、当時の宗教や風習をゲームに組み込んでいます。

en.name: Detention
en.description: Detention is an atmospheric horror game set in 1960s Taiwan under martial law. Incorporated religious elements based in Taiwanese/Chinese culture and mythology, the game provided players with unique graphics and gaming experience.

games.name: F.E.A.R. 2: Project Origin
games.description: 特殊部隊の軍曹マイケル・ベケットとしての日常任務は瞬く間に、アルマ・ウェイドの怒りと狂気に立ち向かう壮絶な生存戦へと変貌する。暴走するアルマの恐るべき力により、部隊は終末世界を戦い進み、彼女を葬るための手がかりを探し求める。

en.name: F.E.A.R. 2: Project Origin
en.description: Assume the role of Special Forces Sgt. Becket as your routine mission quickly turns into a fight for survival against the wrath of Alma Wade. As Alma's terrifying power surges out of control, your squad is forced to battle through an apocalyptic landscape in search of clues for how to destroy her!

games.name: SKALD: Against the Black Priory
games.description: SKALD:Against the Black Priory is a retro-style party-based RPG set in a grim-dark fantasy world of tragic heroes, violent deaths and Lovecraftian horror. en.name: Cube Escape Collection
en.description: In this classic point-and-click adventure anthology you follow the path of Dale and Laura and other famous Rusty lake characters such as Mr. Crow and Mr. Owl. The series will be updated, preserved and bundled to survive the end of the Flash Games era.

games.name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite

en.name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite
en.description: Aliens: Fireteam Elite is a cooperative third-person survival game set in the iconic Alien Universe. Battle through hordes of different types of Xenomorph, customize your character and gear, and level-up as you try to contain this ever-growing threat.
