en.description: Step into Nave, a vast fantasy sandbox world with a player-driven economy, persistent housing, and deep crafting systems. Engage in first-person, full-loot PvP combat with other players and perilous foes. Build, explore, and conquer in an unforgiving world. The land is yours—who will you become?

games.name: Child of Light
games.description: Aurora, a young girl from 1895 Austria, awakens on the lost fairytale continent of Lemuria. To return home she must fight against the dark creatures of the Queen of the Night, who have stolen the sun, the moon and the stars. At stake is not only Lemuria, but Aurora’s true destiny.

en.name: Child of Light
en.description: Aurora, a young girl from 1895 Austria, awakens on the lost fairytale continent of Lemuria. To return home she must fight against the dark creatures of the Queen of the Night, who have stolen the sun, the moon and the stars. At stake is not only Lemuria, but Aurora’s true destiny.

games.name: The Ascent「アセント」
genres: 見下ろし型シューティング
games.description: The Ascentはサイバーパンクの世界観で繰り広げられる、ソロ/協力プレイ対応のアクションシューティングRPGです。皆を支配していた巨大企業、アセント・グループが突如崩壊。無法地帯となった世界で、あなたに生き延びることはできるのでしょうか？

en.name: The Ascent
en.description: The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. The mega corporation that owns you and everyone, The Ascent Group, has just collapsed. Can you survive without it?

games.name: Fatekeeper
games.description: かつて災厄が降りかかったことを伺わせる廃墟が残る、作りこまれた世界へと足を踏み入れよう。このファーストパーソンRPGで剣と魔法の技を極め、遺物、呪文、そして選択を通じて自らの道を切り開くのだ。その過程こそが、自らの在り方を決めることになる。

en.name: Fatekeeper
en.description: Venture into a handcrafted world where ruins whisper of past cataclysms. Master the art of sword and sorcery and forge your path with relics, spells and choices that shape who you become in this first-person RPG.

games.name: South Park™: The Fractured But Whole™
games.shortName: SOUTH PARK: THE FRACTURED BUT WHOLE
games.description: South Park のクリエーター、Trey Parker と Matt Stone が手掛ける新作ゲーム、『South Park:The Fractured but Whole』が登場。2014 年に発売され、ゲーム賞も受賞した『South Park:The Stick of Truth』の続編です。

en.name: South Park™: The Fractured But Whole™
en.description: From the creators of South Park, Trey Parker and Matt Stone, comes South Park: The Fractured But Whole, a sequel to 2014's award-winning South Park: The Stick of Truth.

games.name: Discounty : ドタバタスーパー物語
games.shortName: DISCOUNTY : ドタバタスーパー物語
games.description: このリラックスして楽しめる経営シミュレーションRPGで、自分のディスカウント・スーパーマーケットを経営しよう！小さな町のドラマに巻き込まれたり、お店にレイアウトを整頓して計画したり、儲けの大きい取引契約を結んで、秘密主義者の叔母さんのビジネス帝国を拡大しよう。冷凍フライをもっと沢山販売すれば、この壊れたコミュニティだって癒される...はず？

en.name: Discounty
en.description: Manage your own discount supermarket! Get caught up in small-town drama, organize and plan your shop's layout, and strike lucrative trade deals as you expand your secretive aunt's business empire. Selling more frozen fries will surely heal this broken community...right?

games.name: Indivisible
games.description: 『Indivisible』は、Skullgirlsの開発で知られるLab Zeroの新作アクションRPG、手で描いた素敵なアートやアニメーションの横スクロールゲームです。多様な文化や神話の影響を受けたファンタジー世界を救う為に、反抗的で大胆不敵な少女Ajnaの探険と冒険の物語が始まります!

en.name: Indivisible
en.description: Indivisible is a hand drawn action RPG platformer from Lab Zero, creators of the critically acclaimed Skullgirls! Set in a huge fantasy world, Indivisible tells the story of Ajna, a fearless girl with a rebellious streak who sets out on a quest to save everything she knows from being destroyed.

games.name: Cassette Beasts カセット ビースト
games.shortName: CASSETTE BEASTS カセット ビースト
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
games.description: オープンワールドRPGの世界で繰り広げられるモンスター収集＆ターン制バトルを、今度はオンラインマルチプレイで楽しめる！ フュージョンシステムで2体のモンスターを融合させて、パワフルでユニークな新しいモンスターを生み出そう！

en.name: Cassette Beasts
en.description: Collect awesome monsters to use during turn-based battles in this open-world RPG, now with online multiplayer mode. Combine any two monster forms using Cassette Beasts’ Fusion System to create unique and powerful new ones!

games.name: Gordian Quest
games.description: デッキ構築、戦術型シミュレーション、戦略的思考といったジャンルの最強要素を組み合わせたエピックなローグライク・ライト作品。ヒーローたちを率いて過酷なミッションを乗り越えろ。絆を深め、彼らの新しいスキルを見つけ出せ。世界にかけられた呪いを解き、その中心に君臨する強大な悪を裁け。

en.name: Gordian Quest
en.description: An epic deckbuilding RPG inspired by old-school classics like Ultima and D&D, using modern gaming concepts like roguelite elements and turnbased strategic combat. Lead and nurture parties of heroes. Forge bonds and discover new skills among them. Guide them to unravel the curses laid upon the lands.

games.name: Age of Wonders III
genres: ターン制ストラテジー

games.name: Space Pirates And Zombies 2
games.description: Design and then improve the ultimate mothership. Explore a persistent living galaxy populated by 200 unique captains that can do everything you can do. Survive the zombie infection and then fight them back. Make allies and start your own faction. Build your empire. Also includes Sandbox Mode.

trailers.name: SPACE PIRATES AND ZOMBIES 2 Early Access Trailer
Say Hello To My Little Friends

en.name: Space Pirates And Zombies 2
en.description: Design and then improve the ultimate mothership. Explore a persistent living galaxy populated by 200 unique captains that can do everything you can do. Survive the zombie infection and then fight them back. Make allies and start your own faction. Build your empire. Also includes Sandbox Mode.

games.name: Nice Day for Fishing
games.description: 世界は冒険者を必要としている！ ハニーウッドの英雄として立ち上がるため、しがない漁師のベイリンとなってRPGピクセルアドベンチャーへ出発しよう。正確なタイミングと魔法で魚と戦い、能力を強化し、悪を倒してハニーウッドを再建するのだ！

en.name: Nice Day for Fishing
en.description: The world needs you Adventurer! Embark on an RPG pixel adventure where you’ll play as Baelin the humble fisherman, who must rise-up to become the hero of Honeywood. Battle fish with precision timing and magic spells, upgrade your abilities, defeat evil and rebuild Honeywood.

games.name: Wandering Sword
games.description: Wandering Sword is a Chinese martial-arts RPG where you play a young swordsman caught up in a feud and nearly dies. Escaping the event puts you on the path of pursuing the highest form of martial arts and exploring the pugilistic world to become the great hero you are always destined to be.

en.name: Wandering Sword
en.description: Wandering Sword is a Chinese martial-arts RPG where you play a young swordsman caught up in a feud and nearly dies. Escaping the event puts you on the path of pursuing the highest form of martial arts and exploring the pugilistic world to become the great hero you are always destined to be.

games.name: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos
games.shortName: THE DUNGEON OF NAHEULBEUK: THE AMULET OF
games.description: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk のブッ飛び冒険ファンタジーワールドへようこそ。はみだし者の冴えない勇者たちを率いて、壮大かつ歯ごたえ満点のタクティカル RPG に挑め。笑いと驚き、マヌケな出会いに満ちた冒険が君を待っているぞ。

en.name: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos
en.description: Step into the wacky heroic fantasy universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Lead a team of unlikely and clumsy heroes in an epic and challenging tactical RPG. Live an adventure filled with humor, surprises and silly encounters.

games.name: 永远消失的幻想乡 ～ The Disappearing of Gensokyo
games.shortName: 永远消失的幻想乡 ～ THE DISAPPEARING OF GENSOKYO
games.description: 「永遠消失の幻想郷」は中国の同人サークルMyACG Studioが作った二次創作ゲームです 弾幕射撃＋アクショウゲーム 多様な敵を倒して、ボスたちを挑戦しましょう

en.name: 永远消失的幻想乡 ～ The Disappearing of Gensokyo
en.description: "The Disappearing of Gensokyo" is a Touhou Project doujin game from MyACG Studio, a Chinese doujin game fan circle. We have re-imagined Touhou as an ARPG, creating this "Danmaku-Shooting-ARPG". We hope this game will be a good experience for those who are both new and knowledgeable of Touhou!

games.name: Fable - The Lost Chapters
games.description: Each person you aid, each flower you crush, and each creature you slay will change this world forever. Fable: Who will you be?

en.name: Fable - The Lost Chapters
en.description: Each person you aid, each flower you crush, and each creature you slay will change this world forever. Fable: Who will you be?

games.name: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante
games.shortName: THE LIFE AND SUFFERING OF SIR BRANTE
games.description: 人の運命は生まれながらにして定められ、その運命は実在する神々によって掌握されている…そんな冷徹な世界を舞台にしたストーリー性の高いRPG。生涯の旅に出て、自らの運命を作り上げよう。裁判官や尋問官になるのか、それとも旧体制に陰謀を企てるのか？運命を決めるのは自分だけ！

en.name: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante
en.description: A narrative-driven hardcore RPG set in a gritty world ruled by real but unrelenting gods. Set out on a challenging lifetime journey, where every choice has a price and entails consequences. Will you become an inquisitor, a judge, or conspire against the old order? Dare to decide!

games.name: 觅长生
games.description: 《觅长生》是一款想要还原真实修仙世界的开放世界角色扮演游戏。 在这里，你可以体验到从零开始一步步积攒修为突破境界的逆天修仙之旅，也可以体验到那些充满修仙味的故事和剧情。当然也少不了寻求奇遇、探索秘境，更可以和游戏中的角色互动，与人为善或是杀人夺宝全都由你自己抉择。

en.name: 觅长生
en.description: 《觅长生》是一款想要还原真实修仙世界的开放世界角色扮演游戏。 在这里，你可以体验到从零开始一步步积攒修为突破境界的逆天修仙之旅，也可以体验到那些充满修仙味的故事和剧情。当然也少不了寻求奇遇、探索秘境，更可以和游戏中的角色互动，与人为善或是杀人夺宝全都由你自己抉择。

games.name: Bastion
games.description: 世界を粉々に破壊した非現実的な大惨事、Calamityの秘密を探ろう。

en.name: Bastion
en.description: Discover the secrets of the Calamity, a surreal catastrophe that shattered the world to pieces.

games.name: Ni no Kuni™ II: Revenant Kingdom
games.shortName: NI NO KUNI II: REVENANT KINGDOM
games.description: 陰謀により、国を追われた幼き王「エバン」。 大切な存在との別れを経て、エバンは自らの王国を作る事を決意する。 これは、少年が偉大な王となり、巨悪を討つまでを記した物語である。

trailers.name: Ni no Kuni 2 The Light May Yet Return UNRATED

en.name: Ni no Kuni™ II: Revenant Kingdom
en.description: Join the young king Evan as he sets out on an epic quest to found a new kingdom and, with the help of some new friends, unite his world, saving its people from a terrible evil.

games.name: The Scroll of Taiwu : Beyond The Dome
games.shortName: THE SCROLL OF TAIWU : BEYOND THE DOME
games.description: "The Scroll of Taiwu" is an indie game themed around Chinese mythology and wuxia. Players assume the role of the mysterious "heir of the Taiwu clan" in an alternate ancient China, working through generations of heirs to defeat a powerful hereditary enemy and shape the fate of the human world.

trailers.name: The Scroll Of Taiwu Movie EN

en.name: The Scroll of Taiwu : Beyond The Dome
en.description: "The Scroll of Taiwu" is an indie game themed around Chinese mythology and wuxia. Players assume the role of the mysterious "heir of the Taiwu clan" in an alternate ancient China, working through generations of heirs to defeat a powerful hereditary enemy and shape the fate of the human world.

games.name: Tales of Maj'Eyal
games.description: Tales of Maj’Eyal is a roguelike RPG, featuring tactical turn-based combat and advanced character building. Play as one of many unique races and classes in the lore-filled world of Eyal, exploring random dungeons, facing challenging battles, and developing characters with your own tailored mix of abilities and powers.

en.name: Tales of Maj'Eyal
en.description: Tales of Maj’Eyal is a roguelike RPG, featuring tactical turn-based combat and advanced character building. Play as one of many unique races and classes in the lore-filled world of Eyal, exploring random dungeons, facing challenging battles, and developing characters with your own tailored mix of abilities and powers.

games.name: Heroes of Hammerwatch
games.description: Heroes of Hammerwatch is a rogue-lite action-adventure. Explore and battle your way through procedurally generated levels on your own or with up to 3 friends.

en.name: Heroes of Hammerwatch
en.description: Heroes of Hammerwatch is a rogue-lite action-adventure. Explore and battle your way through procedurally generated levels on your own or with up to 3 friends.

games.name: 妖之郷（あやかしのさと）
games.shortName: 妖之郷（あやかしのさと）
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
games.description: 「妖之郷」は、東方幻想のモンスターコレクションRPGアドベンチャーゲームです。御妖師として太古大陸を探索し、さまざまな妖精と出会い、仲間と共に各地の宗門に挑戦し、妖之郷を作るパートナーを探します。しかし、「黒い月」が広がり、妖精たちは悪魔化になりつつあり、平和な生活が危機に瀕しています。あなた...準備はできていますか。

trailers.name: Yaoling: Mythical Jourey Early Access Release Trailer-JA

en.name: Yaoling: Mythical Journey
en.description: Yaoling: Mythical Journey is a creature collecting Eastern fantasy RPG featuring an world filled with rich stories and unique Yaolings. Tasked to uncover a mysterious evil, you embark on a journey with your Yaolings, forming new friendships, engage in intense battles, and face countless challenges!

games.name: Moon Sweepers
games.description: 掃除するのは月まるごと。最初の道具は歯ブラシ1本。最大16人で協力して月の砂ぼこりを集めて売り、道具をアップグレードし、清掃車両をアンロックしよう。とんでもない仕事を大繁盛のビジネスに変えよう。友達がちゃんと手伝ってくれれば、の話だけど。

en.name: Moon Sweepers
en.description: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

games.name: Tavern Master
games.description: Tavern Masterは、中世の酒場を経営するゲームです。小さな部屋、わずかなテーブルとベンチから始めて、厨房、客室、忠実なスタッフなどを備えた巨大な酒場へと成長させていきましょう！

en.name: Tavern Master
en.description: Tavern Master is all about managing your medieval tavern. You start with a very small room, couple of benches and tables and build your way up to a huge successful tavern with a kitchen, rooms for guests, group of loyal staff and much more!

games.name: Constance
games.description: 《Constance》は、手描きアートで制作されたアクションアドベンチャー。絵筆をあやつる主人公は、自らの病んだ心が生み出した、カラフルながらも退廃的な精神世界から逃れ出るべく奔走する。

en.name: Constance
en.description: Constance is a 2D hand-drawn action adventure featuring a paintbrush-wielding artist, striving to escape from a colorful but decaying inner-world, created by her declining mental health.

games.name: Gatekeeper
games.description: 「Gatekeeper」は高速ローグライクアクション。執拗に沸き出る敵を蹴散らし、ケイオスを追い詰め、奪われた「時間の心臓」を取り戻そう。ソロから最大4人までのプレイが可能。次代のゲートキーパーよ、起動せよ！

en.name: Gatekeeper
en.description: Gatekeeper is a fast-paced rogue-like. Go on a quest to chase down Chaos and reclaim the stolen Heart of Time, fighting your way through relentless enemy forces. Play solo or in 4-player co-op and become the next Gatekeeper!

games.name: Golf With Your Friends
games.description: 友達がいるなら…「みんなでゴルフ」をやらなきゃ意味がない！最大12人で楽しめる、ハイペースでエキサイティングな同時進行の9つのコースでのミニゴルフなら、OBなんてありません！パーティーはまだまだ続きます。早期アクセス中、追加のコースやコンテンツを皆様にお届けする予定予定です！

trailers.name: Golf With Your Friends - Olympus Odyssey Launch Trailer

en.name: Golf With Your Friends
en.description: Why have friends if not to play Golf... With Your Friends! Nothing is out of bounds as you take on courses filled with fast paced, exciting, simultaneous mini golf for up to 12 players!

games.name: Liar's Bar
games.description: このスケッチなバーを舞台にしたマルチプレイヤーオンライン体験に飛び込みましょう。ゲームはパトロンと同じくらい危険です。4人のテーブルに参加し、ライアーズダイスやライアーズデッキでスキルを試しましょう。勝利の鍵は嘘とブラフにあります。ライアーズバーでの夜の準備はできていますか？

en.name: Liar's Bar
en.description: Dive into this multiplayer online experience set in a sketchy bar where the games are as dangerous as the patrons. Join a table of 4 and test your skills in Liar's Dice and Liar's Deck, where lying and bluffing are key to victory. Ready for a night at Liar's Bar?

games.name: Endzone - A World Apart
games.description: Endzoneは、世界的な原子力災害の後、グループの仲間で新しい文明を開拓する、終末世界を描いたサバイバル都市建設シミュレーションである。絶え間ない放射能、有毒な雨、砂嵐や干ばつなどの脅威にさらされた世界で、新たに家を建設し、彼らの生存を確実にしよう。

en.name: Endzone - A World Apart
en.description: Endzone is a post-apocalyptic survival city builder, where you start a new civilization with a group of people after an ecological disaster. Build them a new home and ensure their survival in a shattered world, threatened by constant radiation, toxic rain, sandstorms and droughts.

games.name: MIO: Memories in Orbit
games.description: そこは美しきメトロイドヴァニアの世界。プレイヤーはアンドロイドのMIOとなって、植物が生い茂り、機械が暴走したハイテクノロジーを誇る宇宙船「Vessel」を探っていく。そこに眠る秘密を解き明かし、MIOの能力を高めながら、Vesselとそこに暮らすものたちを忘却の危機から救い出そう。

trailers.name: MIO: Memories in Orbit - Accolade Trailer
MIO: Memories in Orbit - Launch Trailer
MIO: Memories in Orbit - Gameplay Trailer

en.name: MIO: Memories in Orbit
en.description: Play as android MIO in this mesmerizing metroidvania where you explore the Vessel, an enormous technological ark overgrown with machines gone rogue. Uncover its secrets, enhance MIO's abilities, and save the spaceship and its residents from oblivion.

games.name: Chorus
games.description: かつてサークルの最強の戦士だった彼女は、今や最重要指名手配犯だ。ナラと戦闘機のフォーセイクンとして銀河系を渡り、サークルに対抗するレジスタンス勢力を結集し、宇宙を抑圧から解放せよ。

en.name: Chorus
en.description: Take control of Nara on a quest to destroy the dark cult that created her. Unlock devastating weapons & mind-bending abilities in an evolution of the space-combat shooter. Along with Forsaken, her sentient starfighter, explore ancient temples, engage in zero-g combat & venture beyond waking reality.

games.name: Titan Souls
games.description: Between our world and the world beyond lie the Titan Souls, the spiritual source of all living things. Scattered amongst the ruins and guarded by the idle titans charged with their care, a solitary hero armed with a single arrow is assembling shards of the Titan Soul in a quest for truth and power.

en.name: Titan Souls
en.description: Between our world and the world beyond lie the Titan Souls, the spiritual source of all living things. Scattered amongst the ruins and guarded by the idle titans charged with their care, a solitary hero armed with a single arrow is assembling shards of the Titan Soul in a quest for truth and power.

games.name: Hyper Light Drifter
games.description: Explore a beautiful, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers and lost technologies.

en.name: Hyper Light Drifter
en.description: Explore a beautiful, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers and lost technologies.

games.name: アストラル アセント
games.shortName: アストラル アセント
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 『アストラルアセント』は、ファンタジーな世界を舞台とした２Ｄローグライク・アクションアドベンチャーゲームです。４人のキャラクターから主人公を選び、強大な12体の守護者「ゾディアック」に守られた境界の監獄「ガーデン」を攻略していきます。

trailers.name: Astral Ascent - For those who come after - EN
Astral Ascent - The Outer Reaches - EN

en.name: Astral Ascent
en.description: Choose one of four heroes and explore the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful mystical bosses: the Zodiacs. Challenge them with dozens of unique spells and faithful friends by your side to unfold the story of this platform roguelite with lightning fast combat.

games.name: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
games.shortName: SHADOW TACTICS: BLADES OF THE SHOGUN
games.description: 1615年、日本。新たな将軍が日本に君臨し、泰平の世を築く。謀略と反乱に対抗する戦いの中で、彼は暗殺、工作、そして情報収集に長けた5人の専門家を雇う。だが世の安寧の名に下に、彼らは果たしてどこまで犠牲にするつもりなのだろうか。

trailers.name: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun - Gameplay Trailer 2
Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun - Critics Trailer
Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun - Release Trailer

en.name: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
en.description: Shadow Tactics is a hardcore tactical stealth game set in Japan around the Edo period. A new Shogun seizes power over Japan and enforces nationwide peace. In his battle against conspiracy and rebellion, he recruits five specialists with extraordinary skills for assassination, sabotage and espionage.

games.name: Nordhold
games.description: ローグライトの要素とターン制の建設ストラテジーが融合するタワーディフェンスゲームで町を建設し、防衛しよう。ヒーローを選択し、相乗効果のあるタワーをアップグレードして、プロシージャル生成された環境で壮大なバトルを繰り広げよう。

en.name: Nordhold
en.description: Enemies are coming! Every decision matters: build your city, grow the economy, and prepare for enemy waves. Strengthen your defenses, adapt your strategy, and unleash your hero’s full potential. This unique Tower Defense will test your skills – are you worthy to claim a place at Valhalla?

games.name: Journey
games.description: 遺跡の上を飛揚し、煌めく砂漠を滑り降りて、かつての文明を思わせる『風ノ旅ビト』の世界の謎を解き明かしましょう。

en.name: Journey
en.description: Explore the ancient, mysterious world of Journey as you soar above ruins and glide across sands to discover its secrets.

games.name: RUINER
genres: 見下ろし型シューティング
games.description: 『RUINER』は2091年の巨大サイバー都市“レンゴクシティ”を舞台にした、バイオレンス色の強いアクションシューティングゲーム。爆発的な怒りを内に秘めた一人の反逆者が誘拐された兄を救うため、腐敗した社会に牙を剥き、謎の女ハッカーの力を借りながら醜い真実を解き明かす。大都市のいかがわしい裏路地から展開する陰惨なストーリーに没入し、超人的な反射神経とサイバネティック強化ツール、敵の落とす様々な武器を駆使して、“ヴァーチャリティ”を世に広める巨大企業ヘヴン社の野望を打ち砕こう。

en.name: RUINER
en.description: RUINER is a brutal action shooter set in the year 2091 in the cyber metropolis Rengkok. A wired psychopath lashes out against a corrupt system to uncover the truth and retrieve his kidnapped brother under the guidance of a secretive hacker friend.

games.name: Twelve Minutes
games.description: タイムループにとらわれてしまった男にまつわるインタラクティブなスリラー。出演：ジェームズ・マカヴォイ、デイジー・リドリー、ウィレム・デフォー

en.name: Twelve Minutes
en.description: An interactive thriller about a man trapped in a time loop. Featuring James McAvoy, Daisy Ridley, and Willem Dafoe.

games.name: Mini Motorways
games.description: Mini Motorways は、成長を続ける都市の道路を作っていくゲームです。 1つずつ道路を作って道路網を建設し、活気にあふれた大都市を作りましょう。道路を再設計し、戦略的に高速道路を配置して、誰もが必要な場所にたどり着けるようにしましょう。あなたは、都市の交通をどれだけスムーズに管理し続けることができますか？

en.name: Mini Motorways
en.description: Mini Motorways is a strategy simulation game about designing the road map for a growing city. Build a traffic network, one road at a time, to create a bustling metropolis. Redesign your roads and place your motorways to get everyone where they need to go. How long can you keep the city moving?

games.name: Melatonin
games.description: 『メラトニン』は夢と現実が入り混じるリズムゲームです。圧迫感のあるオーバーレイやインターフェースなしに、様々な夢レベルでチャレンジや手描きアート、活気ある音楽を楽しみながら調和してください。

en.name: Melatonin
en.description: Melatonin is a rhythm game about dreams and reality merging together. It uses animations and sound cues to keep you on beat without any intimidating overlays or interfaces. Harmonize through a variety of dreamy levels containing surprising challenges, hand-drawn art, and vibrant music.

games.name: ポーショノミクス シルヴィアの魔法薬店
games.shortName: ポーショノミクス シルヴィアの魔法薬店
genres: 恋愛シミュレーション
games.description: あなたは叔父さんのポーション屋を引き継いだが、店は借金まみれだった！？店を自分好みにカスタマイズし、材料を集め、ポーション作りに取り掛かろう！島の個性的なキャラクターと関係を深め、交渉術を学び、島一番のポーション職人を目指せ！

en.name: Potionomics
en.description: You’ve inherited your uncle’s potion shop—and a huge debt. Better get brewing! Customize your store, hire heroes to gather ingredients, befriend (or romance) fellow vendors to learn new haggling strategies, and go head-to-head with competitors in this narrative-driven, deck-building shop simulator.

games.name: 東方天空璋 ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons.
games.shortName: 東方天空璋 ～ HIDDEN STAR IN FOUR SEASONS.
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
games.description: 桜を見ながら西瓜を割り、紅葉を見ながら鍋をつつく こんな季節に誰がした！ イレギュラーでシーズナルなシューティング幻想！

en.name: Touhou Tenkuushou ~ Hidden Star in Four Seasons.
en.description: 桜を見ながら西瓜を割り、紅葉を見ながら鍋をつつく こんな季節に誰がした！ イレギュラーでシーズナルなシューティング幻想！

games.name: Rift of the NecroDancer
games.description: ネクロダンサーが、まったく新しいリズムゲームになって帰ってきた！見知らぬ新世界に引きずり込まれたケイデンスは、リフトから押し寄せるモンスターたちと音楽で戦うことに！Danny Baranowskyらが手掛けるオリジナルのエレクトリック・サウンドトラックに乗って、すべてのビートが戦いとなる白熱のリズムリフトに挑め。

trailers.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Mystery Skulls Music Pack Trailer
Rift of the NecroDancer Launch Trailer
Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku Music Pack 2 Trailer

en.name: Rift of the NecroDancer
en.description: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

games.name: COCOON
games.description: LIMBOとINSIDEのリード・ゲームプレイデザイナーJeppe Carlsenが送る『COCOON』は、世界の中にある世界を行き来するアドベンチャーゲーム。 世界へ飛び込むシステムを理解して複雑なパズルを解き、宇宙の謎を暴こう。

en.name: COCOON
en.description: From Jeppe Carlsen, the lead gameplay designer of LIMBO and INSIDE — COCOON takes you on an adventure across worlds within worlds. Master world-leaping mechanics and solve intricate puzzles to unravel a cosmic mystery.

games.name: Happy Wheels
games.description: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

en.name: Happy Wheels
en.description: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

games.name: Forager
genres: オープンワールドサバイバルクラフト
games.description: 「一度はじめたらやめられない！」ちょっと風変わりで大人気の放置系ゲームがついに登場。 冒険やクラフト、素材の収集と管理、秘密の発見がキミを待っている！ 冒険し尽くした？新しい土地を買って行き先を拡大しよう！

en.name: Forager
en.description: The highly popular and quirky "idle game that you want to actively keep playing". Explore, craft, gather & manage resources, find secrets and build your base out of nothing! Buy land to explore and expand!

games.name: 東方幕華祭 春雪篇
games.shortName: 東方幕華祭 春雪篇
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
games.description: 弾幕シューティングゲームであり、幕華祭シリーズの二作目にあたります。異変が再び幻想郷を襲い、冥界に向かう少女たちは果たして謎を解くことができるのでしょうか？

en.name: TouHou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part II
en.description: Touhou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival part II is a danmaku shooting game, which is the second part of Touhou Makuka Sai. The repeat of incident is coming again. Can the girls going to the netherworld solve the mystery?

games.name: Witch It
games.description: 『Witch It』は、ユーモアたっぷりの魔法世界で繰り広げられる、マルチプレイヤーのかくれんぼゲームです。勇敢なハンターの使命は、村に呪いをかける魔女たちを見つけること！

en.name: Witch It
en.description: Witch It is a multiplayer hide & seek game set in a vibrant, magical world. Brave hunters seek hidden witches that curse their villages!

games.name: The Sexy Brutale
games.description: 本作「The Sexy Brutale」は、陰謀、殺人そしてオカルトの要素をフィーチャーした、無限に続く仮面舞踏会が舞台だ。 プレイヤーは、リアルタイムで進行するミステリアスかつ人が殺されていく謎の仮面舞踏会を何度も経験することになる。 ゲスト達そして自分自身を救済するためには、全ての謎を解き明かし、無限のループに終止符を打たねばならない

en.name: The Sexy Brutale
en.description: The Sexy Brutale — a never-ending masked ball featuring intrigue, murder and the (quite possibly) occult! Relive the same mysterious day where the guests at the casino mansion are being murdered by the staff over and over again...

games.name: Breathedge
genres: オープンワールドサバイバルクラフト
games.description: 広大な宇宙を生き延びましょう！ 不死身のニワトリと共に、突然の宇宙船事故に隠された謎を解き明かすのです。 生き残って宇宙船の残骸を調査するためには、様々なツールのクラフトやビークルの運転、そして宇宙ステーションの管理さえも必要になってきます。

en.name: Breathedge
en.description: Survive in outer space! Together with your immortal chicken, discover the truth behind your sudden spaceship crash. Craft tools, pilot vehicles, and even control space stations to survive and explore the wreckage.

games.name: Door Kickers
games.description: ドアキッカーズはPC向けのタクティカルゲームです。 タッチスクリーンの為に特別にデザインされた新しい インターフェースを用意し、すべてのアップデートやキャンペーンを詰め込みました。

en.name: Door Kickers
en.description: Door Kickers is an innovative realtime strategy game that puts you in charge of a SWAT team and lets you command them during a tactical intervention.

games.name: Bakery Simulator
games.description: 夜明け前に起床し、パン職人の気分を味わってみましょう！数十種類のパンの焼き方を学びましょう。本物さながらのベーカリーマシンを使用してみましょう。受注したパンをお店に届けてお金を稼ぎ、投資を続けましょう。オリジナルのレシピや材料を試してみましょう。

en.name: Bakery Simulator
en.description: Get up before dawn and see what it's like to be a baker! Learn to bake several dozen types of bread. Use realistic bakery machines. Deliver orders to stores, earn, and invest. Use original recipes or experiment with ingredients.

games.name: 陶芸マスター
games.description: これは陶器をテーマにした作成+シミュレーションゲームです。陶器を作り、展示会を開き、注文を完了し、見習いを訓練し、独自のショールームを運営し、リラックスした陶器の旅を始めましょう。

en.name: Master Of Pottery
en.description: Master of Pottery is a pottery-themed creation + simulation game. Make pottery, open exhibitions, complete orders, train apprentices, run your own showroom and start a relaxing pottery journey.

games.name: Click the Button
games.description: Click the Buttonは、ボタンをクリックして素晴らしい報酬をもたらす宝箱を受け取るインクリメンタルゲームです。スキルを向上させて最強になりましょう。

en.name: Click the Button
en.description: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

games.name: My Friend Pedro
games.description: 『My Friend Pedro』は、ある男が言葉を話すバナナ「ペドロ」に助けてもらいながら弾丸の嵐を駆け抜けるガンアクションゲームだ。

en.name: My Friend Pedro
en.description: My Friend Pedro is a violent ballet about friendship, imagination, and one man’s struggle to obliterate anyone in his path at the behest of a sentient banana.

games.name: Lethal League Blaze
games.description: Banging beats and mad style, Lethal League Blaze is the most intense ball game you can play online with up to 4 players.

en.name: Lethal League Blaze
en.description: Banging beats and mad style, Lethal League Blaze is the most intense ball game you can play online with up to 4 players.

games.name: APE OUT
games.description: 『Ape Out』は、原初の記憶を呼び起こす脱出劇をカラフルに描くSmash-em-upゲームだ。

en.name: APE OUT
en.description: APE OUT is a wildly intense and colorfully stylized smash ‘em up about primal escape, rhythmic violence, and frenetic jazz.

games.name: SUPERHOT
games.description: 『SUPERHOT』は「自分が動くときだけ、時間が進む」ユニークなFPSゲーム。ライフ回復や弾薬の補充などは一切ない。武装した赤いヤツらに立ち向かうのは、自分ひとりだけだ。

trailers.name: SUPERHOT is the most innovative FPS I've played in years

en.name: SUPERHOT
en.description: SUPERHOT is the smash-hit FPS where time moves only when you move. No regenerating health bars. No conveniently placed ammo drops. It's you, alone, outnumbered and outgunned. Snatch weapons from fallen enemies to shoot, slice and dodge through a truly cinematic hurricane of slow-motion bullets.

games.name: FAR: Lone Sails
games.description: かつて海だった場所…滅びゆく文明の残骸が点在する世界…「船」の帆を広げ、風を受けて進め。無数の障害を乗り越え、過酷な天候に耐え抜け。いったいどこまで行けるのか？そして君は何を発見するだろうか？

en.name: FAR: Lone Sails
en.description: Traverse a dried-out seabed littered with the remains of a decaying civilization. Keep your unique vessel going, overcome numerous obstacles and withstand the hazardous weather conditions. How far can you make it? What will you find?

games.name: ビー・マイ・ホード
games.description: ローグライトサバイバル『Be My Horde』で、ネクロマンサーを動かして敵をゾンビのしもべに変え、武器として使え！ 死んだ敵を蘇らせて強大な不死の軍団を作り上げ、魂喰いの力を強化し、この世界を支配せよ。君はこの物語のヴィランなのだから！

trailers.name: Till Death Do Us Part Trailer

en.name: Be My Horde
en.description: Be My Horde is a roguelite survivor where your minions fight for you. Become a formidable necromancer and turn your enemies into a resource! Raise fallen foes, build massive undead hordes, enhance your skills with devoured souls, and conquer the world – you’re the villain in this story.

games.name: チックタック：二人のための物語（Tick Tock: A Tale for Two)
games.shortName: チックタック：二人のための物語（TICK TOCK: A TALE FOR TW
games.description: 二人が迷い込んだのは、時計じかけの奇妙な世界。時計の針が進むにつれ、より複雑になる暗号を解読しここから生きて脱出しなければならない。手分けして手掛かりを探し、話し合って組み合わせよう。意思疎通が二人の命運を握る鍵。必要なのは二つのデバイス、そして音声通話手段だけ。

trailers.name: Tick Tock: A Tale for Two - Out NOW

en.name: Tick Tock: A Tale for Two
en.description: You and your friend are trapped in a mystical world. As time ebbs away you must solve increasingly complex puzzles to escape. Cooperation is key as neither of you have the full picture! Play on two devices, local or remotely, all you need is a voice connection.

games.name: Call of the Sea
games.description: 謎の病に罹ってしまった女性、ノラとなって、草木が生い茂る楽園の島を舞台にしたアドベンチャーパズルを解き進め、行方不明になってしまった夫を探しましょう。映像美の世界へ入り込み、謎と愛の心動かす物語の中で禁じられた秘密を紐解きましょう。

trailers.name: Call of the Sea Accolades Trailer

en.name: Call of the Sea
en.description: Join Norah, a woman plagued by a mysterious illness, in her search for her missing husband in this adventure puzzle game set on a lush island paradise. Immerse yourself in stunning visuals and unlock forbidden secrets in a moving tale of mystery and love.

games.name: Yoku's Island Express
games.description: Meet Yoku, the pint-sized postman protagonist of Yoku's Island Express! Use a unique blend of pinball mechanics, platforming and open world exploration to unlock the secrets of Mokumana Island, help the locals, awaken ancient deities and much more in this amazing new tropical adventure!

en.name: Yoku's Island Express
en.description: Meet Yoku, the pint-sized postman protagonist of Yoku's Island Express! Use a unique blend of pinball mechanics, platforming and open world exploration to unlock the secrets of Mokumana Island, help the locals, awaken ancient deities and much more in this amazing new tropical adventure!

games.name: Surgeon Simulator
genres: 医療シミュレーション
games.description: 「Surgeon Simulator」は、かなりダークなユーモアと命を救うオペを縫合した、過激な手術シミュレーションゲーム。外科医志望のDr.バークを操作して、奇抜な道具を駆使し、ほかならぬドナルド・ドランプその人を含む患者たちの執刀医になろう！…あれはハンマーかな？

en.name: Surgeon Simulator
en.description: Surgeon Simulator is an over-the-top operation sim, stitching together pitch-black humour with life-saving surgery. Become Dr. Burke, a would-be surgeon with a less than conventional toolkit, as he performs procedures on patients including the Heavy from TF2! ...is that a hammer?

games.name: Before Your Eyes
games.description: プレイヤーのまばたきがストーリーをコントロールし結末を決める、心揺さぶられるファーストパーソンのナラティブアドベンチャーに繰り出しましょう。この革新的な技術を使って、喜びと悲しみが交差する記憶の世界への没入体験。プレイヤーの目の前で、主人公の人生が繰り広げられます。

trailers.name: BEFORE YOUR EYES - Announce Trailer JA
Before Your Eyes - The Art of Blinking JP

en.name: Before Your Eyes
en.description: Embark on an emotional first-person narrative adventure where you control the story—and affect its outcomes—with your real-life blinks. With this innovative technique you will fully immerse yourself in a world of memories, both joyous and heartbreaking, as your whole life flashes before your eyes.

games.name: Paralives
genres: 人生シミュレーション
キャラクターカスタマイズ
games.description: Paralives is a life simulation game about building homes, lives and bonds. Through both hardship and success, where will your story take you?

en.name: Paralives
en.description: Paralives is a life simulation game about building homes, lives and bonds. Through both hardship and success, where will your story take you?

games.name: Heave Ho
games.description: 『Heave Ho』は、最大4人で協力＆対戦できるハチャメチャパーティーゲーム！ウデをのばしてギュッとつかんで、ゴールに向かってぶらーんとスイング！ オフラインでもSteam Remote Playを使ったオンラインでも、友だちといっしょのマルチプレイを楽しもう！

en.name: Heave Ho
en.description: Heave Ho is a riotous multiplayer party game for up to four players in couch co-op and versus play, or online with Steam Remote Play. Reach out, get a grip, and swing to victory — or meet your messy end!

games.name: Gold Mining Simulator
games.description: 金鉱夫になろう。熱心に作業をし、地中深くまで採掘し、この世界を探検しよう。あなたはアラスカで最も裕福な人間になることができるでしょう。様々な専門的なの機械を使い、多くのゴールドを見つけよう。

trailers.name: Gold Mining Simulator - Open Beta Update 1.3 Trailer

en.name: Gold Mining Simulator
en.description: Become a gold miner. Work hard, dig deep, explore the world, and you’ll become the wealthiest person in Alaska. Use a variety of specialist machines to find as much gold as you can.

games.name: Moncage -箱庭ノ夢-
games.description: それぞれの面の中には、一見無関係に見えて実は絡み合っている、全く別の世界が広がっている不思議なキューブ。 繋がりを見つけ、謎を解き明かし、新しい世界を切り開き、その背後にある真実を発見してください。

en.name: Moncage
en.description: Moncage is a unique puzzle adventure game where you explore a fascinating world trapped inside a mysterious cube. With each face displaying a unique scene, you’ll have to leverage the illusions and discover the hidden links to solve the puzzle.

games.name: Hob
games.description: Hobの世界に飛び込もう！『Torchlight I』と『Torchlight II』で受賞歴を誇る開発スタジオRunic Gamesから、新しいアクションアドベンチャーが登場。世界を救え。運命をつかめ。

en.name: Hob
en.description: Transform the world of Hob! A new action-adventure from Runic Games, the award-winning studio behind Torchlight I and II. It's your chance. Make it home.

games.name: Glass Masquerade
games.description: Glass Masqueradeにようこそ。私達は、20世紀のアールデコ＆スタンドグラス職人からヒントを得た、芸術的なパズルゲームをお届けしています。隠されたグラスの欠片を組み合わせると、「世界時代展示会」に世界中の様々な文化が詰め込まれた時計とテーマが現れます。

en.name: Glass Masquerade
en.description: Welcome to Glass Masquerade - an artistic puzzle game inspired by Art Deco & stained glass artisans of the 20th century. You need to combine hidden glass pieces to unveil clocks and themes exhibited by various cultures of the world at the 'International Times Exhibition'

games.name: Them's Fightin' Herds
games.description: Them's Fightin' Herdsは、有名な漫画プロデューサーLauren Faustがデザインした、かわいい動物たちが登場する2D格闘ゲームです。キュートでフカフカな外見の下に潜んでいるのは、真剣なファイターです！

trailers.name: Them's Fightin' Herds Trailer (Frosty Faustings XII)

en.name: Them's Fightin' Herds
en.description: Them’s Fightin’ Herds is a 2D fighting game featuring a cast of adorable animals designed by acclaimed cartoon producer Lauren Faust. Beneath the cute and cuddly surface, a serious fighter awaits!

games.name: Keep on Mining! - Worlds
games.description: Keep on Mining! – Worlds は、岩を採掘し、資源を集め、数多くのユニークなワールドを旅しながら、アーティファクトを発見し、ツルハシをクラフトし、さまざまな永続アップグレードを購入していくインクリメンタル採掘ゲームです！

en.name: Keep on Mining! - Worlds
en.description: Keep on Mining! – Worlds is an incremental mining game where you mine rocks, collect resources, and travel through many unique worlds, finding artifacts, crafting pickaxes, and purchasing many permanent upgrades!

games.name: Rivals of Aether
games.description: 「RIVALS OF AETHER（ライバルズ・オブ・エーテル）」は火、水、風、土のエレメントを操る動物のキャラクターを動かして戦う、アメリカ発のインディー2D格闘アクションゲームだ。最大4人でのプレイに対応したローカルプレイやオンラインプレイで遊ぼう。

en.name: Rivals of Aether
en.description: RIVALS OF AETHER is an indie fighting game where warring civilizations summon the power of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth. Play with up to four players either locally or online.

games.name: Donut County
games.description: 『Donut County』は、プレイヤーが地面にどんどん広がっていく “穴”として遊ぶ、物理効果を活用したストーリー性のあるパズルゲームです。かわいいキャラクターに出会い、彼らのゴミを盗み、穴に放り込んでください。

en.name: Donut County
en.description: Donut County is a story-based physics puzzle game where you play as an ever-growing hole in the ground. Meet cute characters, steal their trash, and throw them in a hole.

games.name: Animal Revolt Battle Simulator
games.description: あらゆる種類のラグドールクリーチャー間の面白いバトルを作成できる、究極の物理ベースのサンドボックスバトルシミュレーター！ ユニットクリエーターで自分のモンスターを作ったり、一人称モードで自分で戦闘に参加したり、強力な武器で敵を爆破したりすることもできます！

en.name: Animal Revolt Battle Simulator
en.description: The ultimate physics-based, sandbox battle simulator where you can create funny battles between all sorts of ragdoll creatures! You can also make your own monsters with the unit creator or even join the battles yourself in the first-person mode!

games.name: Pizza Tower
games.description: Pizza Towerは移動、探索、そしてスコアアタックに重点を置いた、スピーディな2Dプラットフォーマーゲームです。90年代のアニメからインスピレーションを得た個性的なピクセルアートと、アップテンポでエネルギッシュなサウンドトラックを特徴としています。

en.name: Pizza Tower
en.description: Pizza Tower is a fast paced 2D platformer, with an emphasis on movement, exploration and score attack. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the cartoons from the '90s, and a highly energetic soundtrack.

games.name: Glass Masquerade 2: Illusions
games.description: Welcome to the Glass Masquerade sequel - an artistic puzzle game inspired by stained glass artisans and Wonderland depictions of the 20th century. You need to combine hidden glass pieces to solve every riddle and free yourself from a tangled dream.

en.name: Glass Masquerade 2: Illusions
en.description: Welcome to the Glass Masquerade sequel - an artistic puzzle game inspired by stained glass artisans and Wonderland depictions of the 20th century. You need to combine hidden glass pieces to solve every riddle and free yourself from a tangled dream.

games.name: Carto
games.description: 『Carto』は、パズルピースのような地図の欠片を自由に繋ぎ合わせて冒険する新感覚パズルアドベンチャーゲームだ！ とある事故でおばあちゃんと離れ離れになってしまった少女「カート」は、とても不思議な力を持っていた。それは、地図の欠片を組み替えて、世界の地形そのものを変化させる力！

en.name: Carto
en.description: Carto is a charming adventure game wrapped around a unique, world-altering puzzle mechanic. Use this power to explore mysterious lands, help a quirky cast of characters, and guide Carto on her journey back to her family.

games.name: Sticky Business
games.description: 小さいけど素敵なビジネスを運営する喜びを体験しよう：ステッカーを作成して、注文をパッキングして、お客様の反応をチェックして、超かわいいショップをインターネットで始めましょう！

en.name: Sticky Business
en.description: Experience the joy of running your own cozy small business: Create stickers, pack orders and hear your customers’ stories. Time to build the cutest shop on the internet!

games.name: Florence
games.description: 25歳のフローレンス・ヨーは、行き詰まりを感じています。彼女の毎日は終わりのない仕事、睡眠、そしてソーシャルメディアに時間を喰われることの繰り返し。しかしある日、クリシュという名前のチェリストに出会い、それは彼女の世界観をガラリと塗り替えることになります。

en.name: Florence
en.description: Florence Yeoh feels a little... stuck. Her life is an endless routine of work, sleep, and spending too much time on social media. Then one day, she meets a cello player named Krish who changes everything about how she sees the world and herself.

games.name: Servant of the Lake
games.description: ラスティレイクの新しいプレミアムアドベンチャーゲーム『Servant of the Lake』で、不気味なヴァンダーブーム邸に足を踏み入れましょう。パズルを解いて兄弟に仕え、彼らの秘密を解明してください。今後発表されるさらなる情報にご期待ください！

trailers.name: 公式リリーストレーラー

en.name: Servant of the Lake
en.description: Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.

games.name: Roots of Pacha
genres: 農場シミュレーション
games.description: かわいい石器時代の農業シミュレーションが登場。パチャ（Pacha）の世界のコミュニティで生活して、アイデアを発見し、作物を適応させ、動物たちと友達になり、村の成長に貢献しましょう。協力プレイを楽しむか、シングルプレーヤーで文明の夜明けの日々を体験してください。

en.name: Roots of Pacha
en.description: The charming and relaxing stone-age farming sim where you live in a thriving community exploring the wonderful world of Pacha. Discover "ideas," domesticate crops, befriend animals, and help your village grow. Play co-op with friends or explore the early days of civilization in single-player.

games.name: Cat Goes Fishing
games.description: Start out on an island with a basic rod. Progress into a radar-wielding master fisher-cat scouring the sea for the biggest and baddest fish. Each fish has unique behaviors that you will learn to exploit as you tailor your arsenal of fishing rods to suit your style of play. Mrrrow!

en.name: Cat Goes Fishing
en.description: Start out on an island with a basic rod. Progress into a radar-wielding master fisher-cat scouring the sea for the biggest and baddest fish. Each fish has unique behaviors that you will learn to exploit as you tailor your arsenal of fishing rods to suit your style of play. Mrrrow!

games.name: Pikuniku
games.description: 『Pikuniku』はヘンテコだけど仕掛けがたくさんある世界で楽しむ、笑いにあふれたパズルアドベンチャーゲームだよ。でも、見た目ほど全てがハッピーなわけじゃないんだ。

en.name: Pikuniku
en.description: Pikuniku is an absurdly wonderful puzzle-exploration game that takes place in a strange but playful world where not everything is as happy as it seems. Help peculiar characters overcome struggles, uncover a deep state conspiracy, and start a little revolution in this delightful dystopian adventure!

games.name: Electrician Simulator
genres: 没入シミュレーション
games.description: 電気技師の役割を担い、職業の基本を学びましょう！コンセントの取り付け、故障した機器の修理、壊れた電化製品の組み立て、電球の交換、お客さんの家への配線の敷設などを行います。電気には冗談が通じないから、必ず2回チェックすること！

en.name: Electrician Simulator
en.description: Take on the electrician role and learn the profession's basics! Install sockets, repair worn-out equipment, assemble broken appliances, replace light bulbs, and lay wires at your customers' homes. Be sure to check everything twice, with electricity there are no jokes!

games.name: In Other Waters
games.description: 謎は異星の海底へと沈む。AIとして彼女を導く新感覚アドベンチャー 。

en.name: In Other Waters
en.description: Play as an Artificial Intelligence guiding a stranded xenobiologist through a beautiful and mysterious alien ocean. A non-violent sci-fi story, enter a world of wonder, fear and vulnerability, unraveling the history and ecology of an impossible planet. What will you discover together?

games.name: SKYHILL
games.description: 第三次世界大戦は終わりました。世界には突然変異体があふれ、あなたの食料は尽きようとしています。あなたは戦って、この恐ろしいホテルを最上階から一階まで下りていく必要があります。武器を作って食料を探し、出口までたどり着いてください。できなければ、あなたは引き裂かれてしまうか、餓死してしましまいます。あるいは、その両方かもしれません…

en.name: SKYHILL
en.description: World War III is over, the world's infested with mutants and your supplies are running out. Fight your way down this damned hotel, from your penthouse on top to the first floor. Craft weapons, search for food and reach the exit. Otherwise you'll be torn apart, starve to death or maybe both...

games.name: SWORN
games.description: 『SWORN』は1～4人協力プレイのアクションローグライクゲーム。闇に染まったアーサー王と円卓の騎士たちが支配する地、キャメロットを探索して奪還しよう。

en.name: SWORN
en.description: SWORN is a 1-4 player co-op action rogue-like. Explore and reclaim a fallen Camelot from the reign of a corrupted Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table.

games.name: REKA
genres: キャラクターカスタマイズ
games.description: スラヴの民間伝承に着想を得た、魔女の魔法とぬくもりに満ちた世界へ。霧に包まれた秋の森を旅しながら、歩く鶏の足小屋を建て、飾り付け、自分好みにカスタマイズしましょう。村人を助け、森の動物を手なずけ、偉大な魔女バーバ・ヤーガのもとで穏やかな魔法を学びましょう。

en.name: REKA
en.description: Step into a cozy, witchy world inspired by Slavic folklore. Build, decorate, and customize your walking chicken-legged cottage as you wander through misty autumn woodlands. Help local villagers, tame forest creatures, and learn gentle witchcrafts under the tutelage of the great witch Baba Jaga.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac
games.description: Now 20% More Evil with the Free Halloween update!

en.name: The Binding of Isaac
en.description: Now 20% More Evil with the Free Halloween update!

games.name: Exit the Gungeon
games.description: あのワケアリな冒険者たちが新たな試練に挑む！何度も繰り返し楽しめる弾幕アクション！

en.name: Exit the Gungeon
en.description: Exit the Gungeon is a small, spin-off 'dungeon climber' immediately following the adventures of the misfit Gungeoneers.

games.name: Everything
games.description: あなたがいま、誰であろうと、何であろうと、どこにいようと、世界の中心で観測するのはあなた、これはそんなゲームです。

en.name: Everything
en.description: Be the Universe in this epic, award-winning reality simulation game - featuring thousands of playable characters, endless exploration, an extraordinary soundtrack and narration from Alan Watts.

games.name: Rain World
games.description: あなたは、壊れた生態系の捕食者であり獲物でもある、旅するナメクジネコです。槍を持ち、産業廃棄物の中で生き残るために十分な食料を狩りますが、油断は禁物。他の大きな生物も同じことを計画しています…それに、ナメクジネコは美味しそうです。

en.name: Rain World
en.description: You are a nomadic slugcat, both predator and prey in a broken ecosystem. Grab your spear and brave the industrial wastes, hunting enough food to survive, but be wary— other, bigger creatures have the same plan... and slugcats look delicious.

games.name: The Escapists
games.description: The Escapists provides players the opportunity of experiencing a light-hearted insight into everyday prison life with the main objective being that of escaping!

en.name: The Escapists
en.description: The Escapists provides players the opportunity of experiencing a light-hearted insight into everyday prison life with the main objective being that of escaping!

games.name: Granny Simulator
games.description: In Granny Simulator there are two players, a feeble old grandmother and her lovely grandson. The grandmothers objective is to complete her every day routine while the grandson utilizes uncanny violence and pure brutality to stop her.

en.name: Granny Simulator
en.description: In Granny Simulator there are two players, a feeble old grandmother and her lovely grandson. The grandmothers objective is to complete her every day routine while the grandson utilizes uncanny violence and pure brutality to stop her.

games.name: Spin Rhythm XD
games.description: Rhythm Dimensionへようこそ。宇宙一ジューシーなビートに乗せてスピン、タップ、フリック、フローしながら色やビートをマッチさせよう。

en.name: Spin Rhythm XD
en.description: Enter the Rhythm Dimension. A homage to classic arcade rhythm games (Guitar Hero, DDR), with a modern aesthetic and soundtrack. Match colours and beats, spin, tap, flick and flow through the juiciest beats in the universe. Supports multiple control styles including MIDI DJ gear on Steam!

games.name: Mini Metro
games.description: Mini Metroは人口が急増する都市に地下鉄網を敷設するストラテジーゲームです。駅と駅の間に線を引くことで、地下鉄が走り始めます。新しい駅が開設するたびに敷き直して、効率的な路線を目指してください。車両、線路、橋などの設備は限られているので上手く使うことがカギです。あなたのネットワークは都市の成長についていけるでしょうか？

en.name: Mini Metro
en.description: Mini Metro is a strategy simulation game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

games.name: Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth
games.shortName: KEN FOLLETT'S THE PILLARS OF THE EARTH
games.description: 12世紀のイングランド：貧困と戦争の時代、ある小さな町で大聖堂の建設が始まる。人々に富と安心できる場所をもたらすために。必死に生きていく人々の人生と運命が交錯する。ゲームはケン・フォレットの世界的ベストセラー『大聖堂』を原作とした三部作です。

en.name: Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth
en.description: 12th century, England: In a time of poverty and war, a small town begins the construction of a cathedral to claim wealth and safety for its people. In their struggle to survive, lives and destinies intertwine. Based on Ken Follett's world-bestseller ‘The Pillars of the Earth’.

games.name: Incredicer
games.description: Incredicer は、ダイスを振って、お金を稼ぎ、アップグレードし、お手伝いハンドを購入して自動化と収入アップを図る、手軽な放置系ダイスゲームです。

en.name: Incredicer
en.description: Incredicer is a short, incremental dice game where you roll dice, earn money, upgrade and buy helper hands to automate and increase your income.

games.name: OneShot: World Machine Edition
games.description: 高いユーザー評価を得たゲームがついにポータブル機に対応。 全く新しいエンジンを採用し、新しいUI、Steam Deckへの対応などを実現しました。 世界を覆すパズル、魅力的な住人、超現実的な環境、そしてゲームの真実実、そしてゲームの真実を明らかにする魅惑的なストーリーが特徴です。

trailers.name: OneShot: World Machine Edition - Trailer - JP

en.name: OneShot: World Machine Edition
en.description: A completely self-contained portable version of one of the highest user-rated games. Built on an entirely new engine with new UI, support for Steam Deck, & more. Features world-bending puzzles, intriguing denizens, surreal environments, and a captivating story about the truth of the game's reality.

games.name: WEBFISHING
genres: キャラクターカスタマイズ
games.description: WEBFISHING a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game! Relax and fish (on the web!)

en.name: WEBFISHING
en.description: WEBFISHING a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game! Relax and fish (on the web!)

games.name: Oriental Empires
games.description: Turn based 4X strategy game, recreating the civilizations of ancient China. Develop your land, build great cities, raise huge armies and fight epic battles, with hundreds of soldiers fighting right on the game map. Advance your technologies, culture and religion to create one of mankind’s biggest empires.

en.name: Oriental Empires
en.description: Turn based 4X strategy game, recreating the civilizations of ancient China. Develop your land, build great cities, raise huge armies and fight epic battles, with hundreds of soldiers fighting right on the game map. Advance your technologies, culture and religion to create one of mankind’s biggest empires.

games.name: Mother Russia Bleeds
genres: ベルトスクロールアクション
games.description: An old-fashioned beat 'em up with big doses of adrenaline and trippiness, somewhere between the classic style of Streets of Rage and the ultra-violence of Hotline Miami. Set in a cold, ruthless Soviet Union, Mother Russia Bleeds aims to conjure up anxiety, unease, and drug-addled frenzy.

en.name: Mother Russia Bleeds
en.description: An old-fashioned beat 'em up with big doses of adrenaline and trippiness, somewhere between the classic style of Streets of Rage and the ultra-violence of Hotline Miami. Set in a cold, ruthless Soviet Union, Mother Russia Bleeds aims to conjure up anxiety, unease, and drug-addled frenzy.

games.name: Rise of Industry
games.description: Put your entrepreneurial skills to the test in the first title in the ROI series as you create & optimise intricate production lines. As an early 20th-Century industrialist, grow your empire & adapt to an ever-changing business landscape with unexpected events that could lead to boom…or bust.

en.name: Rise of Industry
en.description: Put your entrepreneurial skills to the test in the first title in the ROI series as you create & optimise intricate production lines. As an early 20th-Century industrialist, grow your empire & adapt to an ever-changing business landscape with unexpected events that could lead to boom…or bust.

games.name: ビーンバトル
games.description: 人気のバトルロワイヤル ジャンルを独自にアレンジ。 速いペースで進行する複数のラウンドがあり、キルを取ることも生き残ることも同じくらい報酬が与えられます。 チームを組み、復讐し、キングビーンになれ。

en.name: Bean Battles
en.description: A unique take on the popular genre of battle royales. Multiple fast pace rounds that rewards kills just as much as being the last alive. Team up, take revenge, and be the last bean standing.

games.name: Unity of Command II
games.description: Unity of Command II is the sequel to one of the most critically acclaimed strategy games of all time; a game critics called 'the perfect gateway' into computer war games.

en.name: Unity of Command II
en.description: Unity of Command II is the sequel to one of the most critically acclaimed strategy games of all time; a game critics called 'the perfect gateway' into computer war games.

games.name: Overcooked
games.description: 「Overcooked」は、最大4人でローカルマルチプレイを楽しめる、はちゃめちゃ協力クッキングゲームです。仲間のシェフと協力して、お腹を空かせたお客さんが機嫌を損ねて出て行ってしまう前に、数々の美味しい料理を完成させましょう。下ごしらえから調理、給仕に至るまで、全ての工程をクリアしなくてはなりません。

en.name: Overcooked
en.description: Overcooked is a chaotic couch co-op cooking game for one to four players. Working as a team, you and your fellow chefs must prepare, cook and serve up a variety of tasty orders before the baying customers storm out in a huff.

games.name: Orb of Creation
games.description: Orb of Creation is a non-idle incremental-puzzle game in which you recreate the world with nothing but magic and ingenuity. Conjure resources, buy upgrades, and become an all-powerful wizard!

en.name: Orb of Creation
en.description: Orb of Creation is a non-idle incremental-puzzle game in which you recreate the world with nothing but magic and ingenuity. Conjure resources, buy upgrades, and become an all-powerful wizard!

games.name: Ancient Warfare 3
games.description: Dive into a sandbox full of action and customization! Choose from different game modes like deathmatch, conquest, king of the hill, zombie survival and many more. Create your own scenarios and content in the easy to use in-game editors or use one of the 50k+ workshop items from other players...

en.name: Ancient Warfare 3
en.description: Dive into a sandbox full of action and customization! Choose from different game modes like deathmatch, conquest, king of the hill, zombie survival and many more. Create your own scenarios and content in the easy to use in-game editors or use one of the 50k+ workshop items from other players...

games.name: My Dream Setup
genres: デザイン＆イラストレーション
games.description: マイ・ドリーム・セットアップは、あなたがいつも夢見ている部屋を作るシミュレーションゲームです。家具、コンピュータとその付属品、ポスター、写真、観葉植物、その他インテリアのディテールがあなたを待っています。すべてのアイテムを試して、夢のセットアップを完成させましょう。

en.name: My Dream Setup
en.description: My Dream Setup is a simulation game about building the room you've always dreamed of. A huge selection of furniture, computers and their accessories, posters, pictures, plants, and other interior details await you. Try all of them and create your dream setup.

games.name: Orcs Must Die! 2
games.description: Are We There yeti？が新登場！倉庫から手袋を引っ張り出そう、ウォーメイジとソーサレスが偉大な北の大地の砦を守りに向かっている！新登場、氷の洞窟をやっかいな敵から守れ！

en.name: Orcs Must Die! 2
en.description: You’ve tossed, burned and sliced them by the thousands – now orcs must die more than ever before! Grab a friend and slay orcs in untold numbers in this sequel to the 2011 AIAS Strategy Game of the Year from Robot Entertainment.

games.name: Obduction
games.description: A new sci-fi adventure from Cyan, the creators of Myst. Abducted far across the universe, you find yourself on a broken alien landscape with odd pieces of Earth. Explore, uncover, solve, and find a way to make it home.

en.name: Obduction
en.description: A new sci-fi adventure from Cyan, the creators of Myst. Abducted far across the universe, you find yourself on a broken alien landscape with odd pieces of Earth. Explore, uncover, solve, and find a way to make it home.

games.name: Orcs Must Die!
games.description: Slice them, burn them, skewer them, and launch them - no matter how you get it done, orcs must die in this fantasy action-strategy game from Robot Entertainment.

en.name: Orcs Must Die!
en.description: Slice them, burn them, skewer them, and launch them - no matter how you get it done, orcs must die in this fantasy action-strategy game from Robot Entertainment.

games.name: Lonely Mountains: Downhill
games.description: 自転車との二人旅。手付かずの山を駆け降りる、スリリングなライドに出かけよう。深い森、狭い小道、急な川を走り抜けよう。山頂から谷底へと、衝突しないようにレース、ジャンプ、スライド！

en.name: Lonely Mountains: Downhill
en.description: Just you and your bike - take it on a thrilling ride down an unspoiled mountain landscape. Make your way through thick forests, narrow trails and wild rivers. Race, jump, slide and try not to crash - all the way from the peak to the valley!

games.name: Into the Breach
genres: ターン制ストラテジー
games.description: 未来のハイテク戦闘メカを操縦し、エイリアンの侵略から世界を救え！敗北を喫しても、勝利を目指して何度でも再チャレンジ可能。そのたびに新たな挑戦がランダム生成される、ターン制ストラテジーゲーム。

en.name: Into the Breach
en.description: Control powerful mechs from the future to defeat an alien threat. Each attempt to save the world presents a new randomly generated challenge in this turn-based strategy game.

games.name: Crawl
genres: ローカルマルチプレイヤー
games.description: Crawl is the local multiplayer dungeon crawler where your friends control the monsters! Battle through dungeons and power up your hero - if a friend kills you they take your place and it’s their turn to crawl. It's a race to gain enough XP and loot to take on the hulking final boss!

en.name: Crawl
en.description: Crawl is the local multiplayer dungeon crawler where your friends control the monsters! Battle through dungeons and power up your hero - if a friend kills you they take your place and it’s their turn to crawl. It's a race to gain enough XP and loot to take on the hulking final boss!

games.name: SHENZHEN I/O
games.description: BUILD CIRCUITS. WRITE CODE. RTFM.

en.name: SHENZHEN I/O
en.description: BUILD CIRCUITS. WRITE CODE. RTFM.

games.name: Chinese Parents
genres: 人生シミュレーション
games.description: 中国人の、中国人による、万人のための中国人生シミュレーションゲーム。中国の普通の家庭に生まれた子どもが、人生の岐路である大学入試まで時に楽しみながら時に苦しみながら自分らしく生きていくための選択をし続けます。

en.name: Chinese Parents
en.description: In this casual sim set in China, you step into the shoes of an average kid from birth towards the end of your high school. Study hard, have fun, make friends and face your ultimate challenge, the “Gaokao”. What will your life be after that? And when you have a child, will you be a Tiger Parent?

games.name: Slackers - Carts of Glory
games.description: Slackersの素晴らしい世界に足を踏み入れよう！ 思い浮かべてみて：あなたと友達は飲み物を切らしてしまい、お店は閉店間際！ショッピングカートに乗り込み、予測不可能な猛獣を乗りこなし、近道を発見しながら、栄光への道を切り開こう！

trailers.name: Slackers Carts of Glory - Date Reveal Trailer
Slackers Carts of Glory - Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Slackers - Carts of Glory
en.description: Step into the wonderful world of Slackers! Picture this: you and your friends run out of drinks and the store is closing! Hop in a shopping cart, the ultimate eco-friendly marvel, master the art of riding an unpredictable beast, discover shortcuts as you pave your path to glory!

games.name: ScourgeBringer (スカージブリンガー)

en.name: ScourgeBringer

games.name: モンスターハンターワイルズ

en.name: Intravenous 2
