genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
floor2.description: 条件、効果、補正を組み合わせて自分だけのカードを作れ。デッキを構築して死神との勝負に勝て。過ちを一つでも犯せば、絶望へと落ちてしまうだろう。

en.name: Faith in Despair
en.description: Forge your own cards with triggers, actions and modifiers. Shape your deck and gamble against Death itself. Make one mistake and you will descend into despair.

floor2.name: Sophie's Safecracking Simulator
floor2.description: Crack simulated safe locks using real techniques!

en.name: Sophie's Safecracking Simulator
en.description: Crack simulated safe locks using real techniques!

floor2.name: Dub Night Live
floor2.description: マイクを握って、インターネットの動画にアフレコしよう。Dub Night Liveはショートクリップの音声をミュートにし、あなたと最大8人のフレンドに配役を割り当てます。全員が一斉に録音を行い、録音中はお互いの声は聞こえません。そして、完成した映像をパーティー全員で一緒に鑑賞します。アプリ内エディターを使って自分だけのクリップを作成することも可能です。

en.name: Dub Night Live
en.description: Grab a mic and redub the internet. Dub Night Live mutes the cast of a short clip and hands the roles to you and up to 8 friends. Everyone records at once, nobody hears anyone, then the whole party watches the finished cut together. Build your own clips with the in-app editor.

floor2.name: スマートフォン
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
選択方式アドベンチャー
floor2.description: 見知らぬ密室で目を覚ました主人公。 頼れるものは、手元に残された一台のスマートフォンだけ。 通話、メッセージ、アプリなどに残された痕跡をたどりながら、脱出の手がかりを探していく。 しかし、情報を集めるほどに、 この事件の裏に隠された異様な真実が浮かび上がっていく。 スマートフォンを操作して進める、サイコロジカル・ホラーADV。

trailers.name: スマートフォン-プレイデモ映像

en.name: スマートフォン
en.description: 見知らぬ密室で目を覚ました主人公。 頼れるものは、手元に残された一台のスマートフォンだけ。 通話、メッセージ、アプリなどに残された痕跡をたどりながら、脱出の手がかりを探していく。 しかし、情報を集めるほどに、 この事件の裏に隠された異様な真実が浮かび上がっていく。 スマートフォンを操作して進める、サイコロジカル・ホラーADV。

floor2.name: Burgie's Cozy Kitchen
floor2.description: このかわいくてカオスなアイドル料理ゲームで小さなハンバーガー店を経営しましょう。積極的にプレイするか、作業中にデスクトップコンパニオンとして使ってください。✨短い休憩で一日を明るく！ポモドーロ集中ツールとチャット連携機能が含まれています。

en.name: Burgie's Cozy Kitchen
en.description: A tiny active desktop companion you can play at your own pace. Serve cute, picky customers between your daily tasks and enjoy little breaks that brighten your day. ✨ With a built-in Pomodoro mode to help you stay focused while you work, plus stream integration where your chat can place orders!

floor2.name: デスゲームの報告書
floor2.description: デスゲームに参加した全員の死因を特定し、報告書を提出せよ。

en.name: The Death Game Report
en.description: Identify how every participant in the death game died, and submit your report.

floor2.name: Harmonia
floor2.description: 『CLANNAD』や『planetarian〜ちいさなほしのゆめ〜』を生み出した日本のコンテンツブランド・Keyの15周年記念タイトル『Harmonia』。 キャラクターデザインと原画を樋上いたる、音楽を折戸伸治と水月陵、企画を魁が手がけた遠い未来の物語。

en.name: Harmonia
en.description: From renowned visual novel studio Key, which brought you the highly rated visual novel “planetarian~the reverie of a little planet~”, this is “Harmonia”, the latest kinetic novel in the series.

floor2.name: ほりほりドリル
floor2.description: 『ほりほりドリル』はひとりで黙々と遊べる地面採掘、鉱石収集ゲーム。 敵もタイムリミットもない世界でのんびり地下を掘り進めよう！集めた資源を使ってオリジナルのドリルをつくろう！ コツコツ作業とハクスラ風装備システムで、時間を溶かす準備はできていますか？

en.name: DigDigDrill
en.description: DigDigDrill is an underground mining and resource collecting game. Dig freely for minerals and treasures. Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.

floor2.name: The Greenening
floor2.description: 忘れ去られた世界を探検して再び目覚めさせる、短くも健全な放置ゲームの旅。灰を洗い流してその下に隠された秘密を発見し、様々な水やり能力をアップグレードしながら、自分だけの居心地のよい宇宙の庭を育てていきましょう。

en.name: The Greenening
en.description: A short and wholesome incremental journey about exploring and reawakening a forgotten world. Wash away the ashes to discover the secrets hidden beneath, upgrade your versatile watering abilities, and grow your own cozy space garden.

floor2.name: planetarian～雪圏球～
floor2.description: Keyが手がけた本格的SFキネティックノベル『planetarian～ちいさなほしのゆめ～』の前日譚『planetarian～雪圏球～』が、バイノーラル音楽にも対応して登場！ 遠くない未来、プラネタリウム館に配属されて来たコンパニオンロボットと職員たちとの、なにげない幸せの物語。

en.name: planetarian: Snow Globe
en.description: "planetarian: Snow Globe," the prequel to Key's sci-fi kinetic novel "planetarian: The Reverie of a Little Planet," is now available with binaural audio support! Enjoy the story of a companion robot and her coworkers at a planetarium, and the simple joys they find in their everyday lives.

floor2.name: 風水ニャン牌
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
floor2.description: ゲームって、見た目が大事？……面白ければ、それでよくない？猫ミームとローグライク麻雀が出会ったとき、まったく新しい「ニャン牌」が誕生！『風水ニャン牌』は、ローグライクをベースに、猫ミームと風水モチーフを組み合わせた新感覚のライトローグライク・パズルゲーム。神秘の宝物と戦略的な配牌構築が生み出すのは、奇想天外なコンボとスコアが跳ね上がる爽快感！あなたの組み合わせ次第で、予想もつかない「ニャン牌ビルド」が完成します！ さあ、風水の力を操り、最高得点に挑戦しよう！

en.name: Feng Shui Meowjong
en.description: Looks matter? Fun doesn’t?When cat memes collide with roguelike mahjong, a brand-new Meowjong is born! Feng Shui Meowjong is a fresh, lightweight roguelike puzzle game that blends classic mahjong strategy with quirky cat memes and feng shui elements.

floor2.name: Bloons TD 6
floor2.description: 大ヒットのタワーディフェンスゲーム

en.name: Bloons TD 6
en.description: The Bloons are back and better than ever! Get ready for a massive 3D tower defense game designed to give you hours and hours of the best strategy gaming available.

floor2.name: Sugar,sugar,sugarcoat
floor2.description: 『Sugar,sugar,sugarcoat』は、学園が舞台の恋愛シミュレーションノベルゲームです。少女たちと交流を重ね、愛を得ましょう。そしてあなたはその愛を、愛しの悪魔に捧げなければなりません。

en.name: Sugar,sugar,sugarcoat
en.description: "Sugar,sugar,sugarcoat" is a dating simulation game set in a school. Interact with the girls and gain their love. You must then offer that love to the devil you love.

floor2.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
floor2.description: Placid Plastic Duckがマルチプレイに？ レースにミニゲーム、さらに最大50人で集まれるプールまで？ そのとおり！ 友達とまったり過ごして、プールでいちばん気品あふれるアヒルになろう！

en.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
en.description: Placid Plastic Duck in multiplayer? With races, minigames, and a shared pool for up to 50 players? Yes! Chill with friends and become the pool’s most distinguished duck!

floor2.name: フォルスモール
floor2.description: あなたは無限にループするショッピングモールに迷い込んでしまいました。モール内の変化に気づくことができれば、外に脱出できるかもしれません。

en.name: False Mall
en.description: You have wandered into an infinite looping shopping mall in Japan. If you notice changes within the mall, you might be able to escape.

floor2.name: Traveloot
floor2.description: Travelootは、成長する冒険者チームを率いて島々を巡る、ラン制のインクリメンタルゲームです。資源を集め、敵の大群と戦い、分岐するスキルツリーを解放し、新たな仲間を見つけてチームに加えましょう。ソロプレイはもちろん、ローカル協力プレイで友達と一緒に遊ぶこともできます。

en.name: Traveloot
en.description: Traveloot is a run-based incremental game where you guide a growing team of adventurers across islands. Gather resources, fight enemies, unlock branching skill tree, and find new party members to join your team. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

floor2.name: q.u.q.
floor2.description: q.u.q.は砂漠をさまようちょっとがさつな少女を描いたシュールなビジュアルノベル。

en.name: q.u.q.
en.description: q.u.q. is a surreal visual novel about a somewhat crude girl that wanders a desert.

floor2.name: Rock Simulator
floor2.description: あなたがずっと思い描いていた、責任も借金も心配もない岩になりましょう。 あなたがやるべきことはただ存在し、時間が消えていくのを見ることだけ…。

en.name: Rock Simulator
en.description: Become what you have always imagined, a rock with no responsibilities, no debt, and no worries. The only thing on your checklist is to exist and watch as time fades away...also to become the golden rock.

floor2.name: Shadow Man Remastered
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
floor2.description: He is coming, stalking criminals in the spirit world and the real world. A possessed man is coming, a voodoo mask in his chest and lines of power in his back. Shadow Man is coming, trailing evil from Liveside to Deadside. To stop an apocalypse. To save your soul.

en.name: Shadow Man Remastered
en.description: He is coming, stalking criminals in the spirit world and the real world. A possessed man is coming, a voodoo mask in his chest and lines of power in his back. Shadow Man is coming, trailing evil from Liveside to Deadside. To stop an apocalypse. To save your soul.

floor2.name: HER TREES : THE PUZZLE HOUSE
floor2.description: ハーツリーズ：ザ・パズルハウスは、 物を動かし組み合わせてパズルを解く、 独創的なポイント＆クリック・パズルゲームです。 この奇妙な部屋の謎を解き明かそう。

en.name: HER TREES : THE PUZZLE HOUSE
en.description: HER TREES : THE PUZZLE HOUSE is a unique point-and-click puzzle game where you move and combine objects to solve puzzles. Uncover the mysteries of this peculiar room.

floor2.name: GAROU: MARK OF THE WOLVES
floor2.description: 『餓狼 MARK OF THE WOLVES』は、SNKのゲームプラットフォーム「NEOGEO」にて1999年に発売された対戦格闘ゲームです。『餓狼伝説』シリーズの後継作として、“ロック・ハワード”を新主人公に迎え、キャラクターとストーリーを一新。今回のSTEAM版では、NEOGEO版の完全移植に加え、オンライン対戦にも対応。

en.name: GAROU: MARK OF THE WOLVES
en.description: “GAROU: MARK OF THE WOLVES”, the latest entry in the legendary "FATAL FURY" Series which still continues to fascinate players around the world to this day, returns for a new fight on Steam!

floor2.name: Paper Beast
floor2.description: 電脳世界の深淵に生まれたエコシステムを探索するパズルアドベンチャーゲーム。謎の力がこの場所の均衡を崩している。不思議な生き物たちと一緒にこの世界の謎を解き明かそう。

en.name: Paper Beast
en.description: An exploration and adventure game about wildlife sprung from the depths of the internet. An unknown power seems to upset its balance. Join forces with exotic creatures to unravel the mysteries of this universe.

floor2.name: 少女と宇宙の物語
floor2.description: Milkmaid of the Milky Way is an award-winning point-and-click adventure game in rhyme that combines a gripping story with puzzles and exploration. What happens when a young milkmaid sees an alien craft in a fjord in 1920's Norway?

en.name: Milkmaid of the Milky Way
en.description: Milkmaid of the Milky Way is an award-winning point-and-click adventure game in rhyme that combines a gripping story with puzzles and exploration. What happens when a young milkmaid sees an alien craft in a fjord in 1920's Norway?

floor2.name: マインコップ
floor2.description: 『マインドコップ』は「犯人捜し」を中心とした非線形の探偵ゲームで、ストーリー主体のアドベンチャーとリアルタイムのマッチ3パズルが融合しています。プレイヤーは「マインドコップ」として容疑者の心の中に入り込み、彼らの秘密を明らかにして、嘘を解明していきます。

en.name: Mindcop
en.description: Mindcop is a non-linear „whodunnit“ detective game. It mixes a story driven adventure with real-time puzzle gaming. As the infamous Mindcop, you can dive into the minds of your suspects to uncover their secrets and unravel their lies.

floor2.name: 焼肉シミュレーター
genres: 人生シミュレーション
floor2.description: 【ゲーム紹介】 お腹が空いた？焼肉食べたい？でもカロリーが気になる？ そんな時には「焼肉シミュレーター」！牛タン、ハラミ、上カルビ、カルビがアナタを待っています！ 「焼肉シミュレーター」ならいくら焼いてもカロリーゼロ！思う存分焼いちゃいましょう！ ※ライス、ビールは必要に応じて各々ご用意ください。

en.name: Yakiniku simulator
en.description: Simple and easy game! Just chill out and simulate eating yakiniku!

floor2.name: Rusty's Retirement
genres: 農場シミュレーション
デスクトップコンパニオン
floor2.description: 画面下部の農場で作物を育て、燃料を作り、農業を自動化させる、他のことをしながら楽しめる『ながら』放置農業ゲーム。

en.name: Rusty's Retirement
en.description: A relaxing idle-farming simulator that sits at the bottom of your screen while you do other things.

floor2.name: Stacklands
floor2.description: スタックランドは、カードを重ねて食料を集め、建造物を建て、クリーチャーと戦う村づくりゲームだ。🃏 例えば、「村人」のカードを「ベリーの木」に重ねると、村人たちが生き残るのに必要な「ベリー」が採れるんだ。🃏カードをうまく使って、村を発展させていこう！

en.name: Stacklands
en.description: Stacklands is a village builder where you stack cards to collect food, build structures, and fight creatures. 🃏 For example, dragging a Villager card on top of a Berry Bush card will spawn Berry cards which the villagers can eat to survive. 🃏 Play your cards right and expand your village!

floor2.name: たこパ サバイバル
floor2.shortName: たこパ サバイバル
floor2.description: タンパク質、炭水化物、脂質をバランスよく摂取して生き延びてください。 たこ焼きに入れる具材によって栄養バランスが変化します。 カロリーがオーバーするとお腹いっぱいで食べられなくなりますので、スクワットでカロリーを消費してください。

en.name: Takoyaki Party Survival
en.description: You should consume a good balance of protein, carbohydrates, and fats to survive. The nutritional balance changes depending on the ingredients you put in your takoyaki. If you are overloaded with calories, you will be too full to eat, so please consume calories by squatting.

floor2.name: Gorogoa
floor2.description: ジェイソン・ロバーツ（Jason Roberts）により開発され、グラフィックスが作成された『ゴロゴア』（Gorogoa）は、パズル分野の新たな進化とも言える、美しい手描きのストーリーです。

en.name: Gorogoa
en.description: Gorogoa is an elegant evolution of the puzzle genre, told through a beautifully hand-drawn story designed and illustrated by Jason Roberts. Winner of Debut Game at the 2018 BAFTA Games Awards, as well as Best Mobile Game and the Innovation Award at the GDC 2018 Choice Awards.

floor2.name: RoboDunk
floor2.description: 史上初のバスケットボール・ローグライトゲームで宇宙からDUNKを決めよう！繰り返し遊べるシングルプレイヤー・協力キャンペーンでかっ飛ばせ。ロボットを購入して、その能力値を強化して、豊富に用意された新たなスキルをアンロックしよう。色んな敵、トラップ、報酬の中から好きな道を選べ。毎試合展開が異なる最大4人対戦ゲームだ！

en.name: RoboDunk
en.description: DUNK FROM SPACE in the 1st basketball roguelite! Smash and blast in the replayable single player and coop campaign: buy robots, upgrade their stats and unlock tons of new skills. Choose your path among different opponents, traps and rewards.. Up to 4 players versus where every match is different!

floor2.name: Age of Borders: WW3
floor2.description: 世界が第三次世界大戦の瀬戸際へと向かう中、現実世界のマップ上で200以上の国からひとつを選び、指揮を執ろう。世界各地の9つの火種がエスカレートしていくなか、産業、外交、軍をリアルタイムで動かせ。結末が平和か、超大国同士の戦争か、核による破滅かは、あなたの選択で決まる。

en.name: Age of Borders: WW3
en.description: Take command of any of over 200 nations on a real-world map as the world edges toward World War III. Manage industry, diplomacy and armies in real time while nine global flashpoints escalate. Your choices determine whether it ends in peace, a superpower war or nuclear ruin.

floor2.name: UltraNothing
floor2.description: Nothing to See Here... 2D Puzzle Strategy (not RPG) Platformer.

en.name: UltraNothing
en.description: Nothing to See Here... 2D Puzzle Strategy (not RPG) Platformer.

floor2.name: Blockappend
floor2.description: A 3D puzzle game where you append blocks to each other by flipping them around.

en.name: Blockappend
en.description: A 3D puzzle game where you append blocks to each other by flipping them around.

floor2.name: もっともっとトウモロコシ
floor2.shortName: もっともっとトウモロコシ
genres: 農場シミュレーション
floor2.description: トラクターの農機を長く伸ばして、もっと多くのトウモロコシを収穫しましょう。レアなトウモロコシを集めて、報酬を手に入れましょう。

en.name: Never Enough Corn
en.description: Extend your tractor equipment to harvest more corn. Collect rare corn and earn rewards.

floor2.name: 1989 After the War
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
floor2.description: An atomic war has reduced the world to a heap of ruins. However, there are still those who refuse to give up and seek to bring justice even in this chaos. Use your blade, granades and shotgun to fight your way through this post-apocalyptic scrolling action-platformer in pure 80s arcade style.

en.name: 1989 After the War
en.description: An atomic war has reduced the world to a heap of ruins. However, there are still those who refuse to give up and seek to bring justice even in this chaos. Use your blade, granades and shotgun to fight your way through this post-apocalyptic scrolling action-platformer in pure 80s arcade style.

floor2.name: 東方夜光幻夢 ～Touhou Endless Dream
floor2.shortName: 東方夜光幻夢 ～TOUHOU ENDLESS DREAM
floor2.description: 東方夜光幻夢は、ローグライク要素を含む2Dトップダウン弾幕シューティングゲームです。 プレイヤーはさまざまな能力を持つキャラクターを使用し、強力なアイテムを集めて組み合わせることができます。 すべてを飲み込む闇からあなたと幻想郷を救うために、終わりのない弾幕と踊りましょう。

en.name: Touhou Endless Dream
en.description: A bullet hell roguelike game. Players can utilize characters with different abilities, collect and assemble powerful items. Dance through an unending barrage of bullets to save both yourself and Touhou Gensokyo from the darkness that is engulfing everything.

floor2.name: A Juggler's Tale
genres: パズルプラットフォーム
floor2.description: あなたの操るのは、糸操り人形のアビィ。謎を解き、罠を避け、追っ手を振り払いつつ、危険の潜むおとぎ話の世界を歩みます。

en.name: A Juggler's Tale
en.description: Lead Abby the string puppet through a bruised, but beautiful fairy tale world in this cinematic adventure. Solve riddles, evade traps and shake off pursuers on the way to find freedom. Can Abby take control of her fate with all the strings attached?

floor2.name: Hiveswap Friendsim
floor2.description: You’ve crash landed on a dangerous alien planet with no food, medicine, or prospects, but you do know one thing—you are absolutely desperate for friendship.

en.name: Hiveswap Friendsim
en.description: You’ve crash landed on a dangerous alien planet with no food, medicine, or prospects, but you do know one thing—you are absolutely desperate for friendship.

floor2.name: Plantera 2: Golden Acorn
floor2.description: 丸くて青いヘルパーたちが再び戻り、庭の世話をしながら、かつてこの地に種を残したと言われる大きな魔法のオークを育てます。 オークを大切に育て、空高くまで成長させて黄金のどんぐりを収穫しましょう。

en.name: Plantera 2: Golden Acorn
en.description: The round blue Mellows return to tend to the Garden once more. Grow plants, bushes, trees, animals, water features and the great magical oak tree that has been rumored to have placed its seed there. Tend to the oak tree and grow it to the sky to harvest its Golden Acorns.

floor2.name: BZZZT: バズボット！
genres: 精密プラットフォーム
floor2.description: 小さなロボット「ZX8000」を操作し、数々のプラットフォーム系ゲームの名作にインスパイアされた、美しいドット絵の世界へ旅立とう。お茶目なストーリーを進めてスキルを磨き、激ムズステージのクリアタイムをほかのプレイヤーと競え!

en.name: BZZZT
en.description: Become a tiny ZX8000 robot and begin your journey through a beautiful, pixel-art world inspired by games iconic to the platformer genre. Follow a cute story, upgrade your skills, beat challenging levels, and compete with other players for the fastest speedrun!

floor2.name: DEFRAG
floor2.description: DEFRAGは、汚染されたセクターを浄化し、最適化を通じてより強力なビルドを完成させていくゲームです。 資源を集め、設定を調整し、進行に合わせてシステムを仕上げてください。

en.name: DEFRAG
en.description: DEFRAG is a game about cleansing corrupted sectors and refining them through optimization to build a stronger system. Collect resources, adjust configurations, and complete your build as you progress.

floor2.name: トルービズの秘薬師
floor2.description: 言語解読ゲームはなんぼあってもいいですよね。薬師として、架空の言語で書かれたマニュアルを読み解き、ポーションを調合して患者に処方していく短編パズルゲームです。“読めるようになる”快感と、治療の結果で変化する小さなドラマが楽しめる、手軽な言語解読体験を提供します。

en.name: The Apothecary of Trubiz
en.description: A short puzzle game where you decipher a fictional language, mix potions, and treat patients. Enjoy the thrill of understanding and the small stories that unfold from each cure.

floor2.name: マイエクササイズ
floor2.description: さあ、腹筋しよう。 太っちょの少年に運動をさせることで、その体を秋田犬へと沈み込ませよう。きっと他の動物たちも応援に駆けつけてくれるはず。

en.name: My Exercise
en.description: Let's do sit-ups! Let a chubby boy do his exercise and sink into a dog's body. Maybe animals will come to cheer him up.

floor2.name: Valfaris: Mecha Therion
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
floor2.description: あのセリオンが帰ってきた。ヴロール卿を倒す旅は続く。2.5D横スクロールのシューティングゲームで、高度な殺人マシンを操縦しよう。高い評価を得た「Valfaris」の続編で、覚悟を決めて地獄のマシンを解き放て！

en.name: Valfaris: Mecha Therion
en.description: Therion returns as the hunt for Lord Vroll continues. Pilot an advanced machine of death and destruction in this explosive 2.5D side-scrolling shoot ‘em up, and sequel to the critically acclaimed Valfaris. Strap in and unleash mecha hell!

floor2.name: Hidden Paws Mystery
floor2.description: このネコはここで何を？ 仲間のネコたちはどこ？ 不思議で美しい島を探索して、かくれんぼしているネコたちをすべて見つけ出しましょう。

en.name: Hidden Paws Mystery
en.description: What is this cat doing here? And where are his friends? Explore strange and beautiful islands to find all the little kittens hidden there.

floor2.name: Unrailed!
floor2.description: 「Unrailed!」は、協力マルチプレイヤーゲームです。友達と一緒にタッグを組んで、自動でどこまでも生成されていく世界中に電車の線路を敷きましょう。ランダムな住人と出会い、電車をアップグレードして、脱線を防ぎましょう！

en.name: Unrailed!
en.description: Unrailed! is a co-op multiplayer game where you have to work together with your friends to build a train track across endless procedurally generated worlds. Master random encounters with its inhabitants, upgrade your train and keep it from derailing!

floor2.name: Maskmaker
floor2.description: In an all new mysterious universe built by the developers of the award-winning A Fisherman's Tale, you play as a Maskmaker's apprentice and learn the magic of crafting masks to immerse yourself in the intriguing enigmatic beings within the game.

en.name: Maskmaker
en.description: In an all new mysterious universe built by the developers of the award-winning A Fisherman's Tale, you play as a Maskmaker's apprentice and learn the magic of crafting masks to immerse yourself in the intriguing enigmatic beings within the game.

floor2.name: Alchemist's Garden
floor2.description: Alchemist's Garden is a cozy and relaxing incremental crafting game. Forage to uncover hidden ingredients across mystical lands. Experiment with them at your crucible to discover potions and items, stock your shop's shelves, and watch your potion shop grow!

en.name: Alchemist's Garden
en.description: Alchemist's Garden is a cozy and relaxing incremental crafting game. Forage to uncover hidden ingredients across mystical lands. Experiment with them at your crucible to discover potions and items, stock your shop's shelves, and watch your potion shop grow!

floor2.name: 心霊物件
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 格安アパートで始まる新生活。 夜中の奇妙な現象と隣人の不審な行動が主人公を追い詰めていく。

en.name: Haunted Property
en.description: A new life begins in a low-cost apartment. Strange occurrences at night and the suspicious behavior of neighbors gradually push the protagonist to the edge.

floor2.name: WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES
floor2.description: WORLD OF ART - learn with JIGSAW PUZZLESへようこそ！ 1600+枚以上のアート作品を探索し、リラックスしたクラシック音楽と共にパズルを解きながら脳を鍛え、追加料金なしで楽しもう！

trailers.name: World of Art Jigsaw Puzzles - Spring 2023 Gallery Size

en.name: WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES
en.description: Welcome to WORLD OF ART - Learn with JIGSAW PUZZLES! Explore over 2000+ artworks, solve puzzles, test your knowledge with quizzes, and enhance your mind while enjoying classical music. New paintings added for free regularly!

floor2.name: Andro Dunos II
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
floor2.description: Viscoスタジオのshoot’em upがコンソールに！ アンドロデュノス2に古き良き宇宙船を持ち出しましょう。

en.name: Andro Dunos II
en.description: The sequel of the famous Shoot'em up from the Visco studio is back, 30 years after the first opus, released exclusively on Neo-Geo MVS and Neo-Geo AES in 1992 . It's time to bring out your good old battle ship in ANDRO DUNOS 2!

floor2.name: 闇鍋人狼
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
floor2.description: 闇鍋人狼は皆で鍋を作る正体隠匿ゲームです。仲間同士で相談してダンジョンで食材を集め、おいしい鍋を作ります。ただし、中には裏切り者が紛れていて鍋を作るのを邪魔してくるかも……。お互いの正体を隠しながら理想の鍋を作ろう！

en.name: Hodgepodge Hunch
en.description: Hodgepodge Hunch is a who-done-it game where everyone chips in to make a hotpot dish. Collaborate with your buddies to collect ingredients in the dungeons and whip up a delicious feast. There's just one problem... A backstabber may be lurking among you who'll throw your dinner plans awry...

floor2.name: Travellin Cats in USA
floor2.description: アメリカ合衆国の複数の象徴的な都市に隠れた何百匹もの猫を見つけよう。元祖バイラル「隠れネコ」ゲームのクリエイター Travellin Cats による、かわいい手描きの隠しオブジェクトゲームです！

en.name: Travellin Cats in USA
en.description: Find hundreds of cats hidden in multiple iconic cities of the United States of America in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!

floor2.name: 霜夜ゆく
genres: 選択方式アドベンチャー
floor2.description: 『霜夜ゆく』は方程式アドベンチャーゲームです。 密航者の〈少女〉と協力しながら、不用品を探して投棄しましょう。そして彼女を載せたことで発生した余剰重量——見た目よりいくらか、だいぶん、その、なんというか、かなり重いその重量を補いましょう。そして、まだ宇宙が完全に冷たく、冷え切ってはいないことを証明しましょう。さぁ、パイロット、あなたの出番です。

en.name: Cold Bed on Route
en.description: "Cold Bed on Route" is an equation-like adventure game. Work with to find and dump unwanted items. Then, let's make up for the excess weight caused by having her on board. And let's prove that the universe is not yet completely cold and frigid. Now, pilot, it's your turn.

floor2.name: Historias de Dean Archer: El Detective Desaparecido
floor2.shortName: HISTORIAS DE DEAN ARCHER: EL DETECTIVE D
floor2.description: A detective vanished. An office locked from the inside. You were his last appointment. Investigate every corner and uncover what Dean Archer hid. A noir point & click adventure in a city that prefers not to look.

en.name: Dean Archer Stories: The Missing Detective
en.description: A detective vanished. An office locked from the inside. You were his last appointment. Investigate every corner and uncover what Dean Archer hid. A noir point & click adventure in a city that prefers not to look.

floor2.name: 少女機兵
floor2.description: 2060年、南極の古代遺跡から漏洩したナノ兵器が生物を強力な兵器へ変異させ人類を襲撃。連合軍が劣勢の中、最優秀指揮官であるプレイヤーは実験型第3世代人型機兵部隊の臨時指揮官に任命され、市民が軌道上へ避難するまで最前線で防衛任務に就く。

en.name: Maid Mech
en.description: In 2060, nanoweapons leaked from an Antarctic ancient ruin transformed Earth lifeforms into deadly bioweapons. As human forces retreat, you—a top frontline commander—are tasked with leading experimental 3rd-gen mech units to defend the most critical zone until civilians evacuate to near-Earth orbit.

floor2.name: Grow Up
floor2.description: Leaping from mind-boggling heights, bouncing off Champolines, soaring inches from floating islands, BUD can do it all - that look of mild terror, that’s his daredevil face. Help the adorable little robot collect MOM’s scattered ship parts and return them to the moon.

en.name: Grow Up
en.description: Leaping from mind-boggling heights, bouncing off Champolines, soaring inches from floating islands, BUD can do it all - that look of mild terror, that’s his daredevil face. Help the adorable little robot collect MOM’s scattered ship parts and return them to the moon.

floor2.name: OPUS 魂の架け橋
floor2.description: 終末の世界、そこが広大で美麗なる冒険の舞台。教会の祭壇、工業地区の爆発跡、隔離された都市などを訪れ、巫女とロケット技師が求める材料を探し出そう。「宇宙葬」を通して犠牲者の霊魂を生命の始まりの地——銀河へと送る為に。

en.name: OPUS: Rocket of Whispers
en.description: Rocket of Whispers is an award-winning post-apocalyptic adventure that follows two survivors on a journey to launch a space burial for the lost souls of their desolate world. Help them search the snowy wasteland for supplies and the courage to say goodbye.

floor2.name: Tiny Terraces
genres: 農場シミュレーション
floor2.description: 居心地の良い農作業ゲーム。テラスの周りで人々が仕事をするのを見守りながら、タイニーテラスを拡張、発展、装飾していこう。

en.name: Tiny Terraces
en.description: A cozy idle farming game, watch tiny guys do tasks around the terrace, expand, progress, and decorate your Tiny Terrace.

floor2.name: Disc Room
floor2.description: キミは科学者として調査を行うためディスクへ乗り込むことになる。 しかし、そこに待ち受けていたのは鋭い金属音を立てる無数のディスクと、何度でも死が許される謎めいた空間だった…。

en.name: Disc Room
en.description: Are you ready to get sliced in half? The year is 2089 and a giant disc has appeared in orbit of Jupiter. Step into the oversized space suit of a brave scientist and explore this sprawling intergalactic slaughterhouse.

floor2.name: Shaolin vs Wutang
floor2.description: Shaolin vs Wutang is a INDIE love letter to Martial Arts and classic Kung Fu films. Made for casual game fans not intended for Hardcore Fighting Game players.

en.name: Shaolin vs Wutang
en.description: Shaolin vs Wutang is a INDIE love letter to Martial Arts and classic Kung Fu films. Made for casual game fans not intended for Hardcore Fighting Game players.

floor2.name: 小さな世界
floor2.description: リラックスできるローポリ立体ゲーム。心地よい3D環境で間違い探しを楽しめます。

en.name: Tiny Lands
en.description: Take your perceptivity to a new dimension in a relaxing low-poly isometric puzzle game. Find the differences in the beautiful, fully rotatable, and zoomable 3D environments. Can you find them all?

floor2.name: Pixel Cafe
floor2.description: Pixel Cafeは小さな町の少女の家族、人間関係、コーヒー、そして大都市での生活についての成長物語を描いています。このゲームでは、アーケードスタイルのタイムマネージャーとビジュアルノベルを完璧に融合させ、二つのストーリーラインと美しく作り込まれたピクセルアートの世界を探索します。

en.name: Pixel Cafe
en.description: Step into Pixel's shoes in this one-of-a-kind journey that bridges time, memories, and the aroma of fresh coffee. Dive deep into a city balancing its past and future. Engage in intense arcade challenges, immerse yourself in heartfelt stories, and navigate a world crafted in pixel art.

floor2.name: Stilt Fella
floor2.description: 竹馬で歩き、障害物を乗り越える、やりごたえ抜群の物理学ベース・アーケードゲーム。日本語でプレイ可能！

en.name: Stilt Fella
en.description: Become the fella. Walk on the stilts.

floor2.name: Without a Dawn
floor2.description: Without a Dawn は心に染み入る美しさを持ったアスキーアート風の映像を特徴とする、暗く心理的かつ哲学的なビジュアルホラーノベル。

trailers.name: Without a Dawn - Announcement Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Without a Dawn
en.description: Without a Dawn is a dark, psychological, and philosophical visual horror novel featuring hauntingly beautiful pseudo-ASCII art.

floor2.name: Anarcute
floor2.description: アナーキーキュートとは、暴動をその名の通りキュートに描いたこれまでにないストリートファイトゲーム。かわいい仲間と一緒に楽しい映像でゲームが楽しめます！

en.name: Anarcute
en.description: Anarcute is a rampaging riot simulator, combining adorable aesthetics with huge-scale chaos, colourful destruction and crowd-beat’em all gameplay!

floor2.name: Milk inside a bag of milk inside a bag of milk
floor2.shortName: MILK INSIDE A BAG OF MILK INSIDE A BAG O
floor2.description: A short story about what sort of challenges everyday little things can be. Help the girl buy milk, be the first not to disappoint her.

en.name: Milk inside a bag of milk inside a bag of milk
en.description: A short story about what sort of challenges everyday little things can be. Help the girl buy milk, be the first not to disappoint her.

floor2.name: Empire Earth: Gold Edition
floor2.description: With dozens of hours of gameplay set across a rich tapestry of time, Empire Earth: Gold Edition offers real-time strategy for the ages. Choose any point in time - from the discovery of fire to the laser battles of the future - and command your civilization with one goal: make Earth your Empire.

en.name: Empire Earth: Gold Edition
en.description: With dozens of hours of gameplay set across a rich tapestry of time, Empire Earth: Gold Edition offers real-time strategy for the ages. Choose any point in time - from the discovery of fire to the laser battles of the future - and command your civilization with one goal: make Earth your Empire.

floor2.name: Mosaic of The Pharaohs
floor2.description: Mosaic of The Pharaohs は、ピクロスとマインスイーパーを融合させたゲームで、超巨大なエジプト学をテーマにしたパズルが特徴です。

en.name: Mosaic of The Pharaohs
en.description: Mosaic of The Pharaohs is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle inspired by Egyptology

floor2.name: Regular Factory: Escape Room
floor2.description: 通常の組立ラインでは作業しません。この脱出口では、秘密の工場で実際に何が作られているのかを調べ、神秘的な場所を探索し、パズルを解かなければならない。真実を発見しますか？

en.name: Regular Factory: Escape Room
en.description: You don't work in a regular assembly line. In this escape room, you will investigate what is really being manufactured in a secret factory, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles. Will you discover the truth?

floor2.name: Split Brain
genres: パズルプラットフォーム
floor2.description: 友達と同じキャラクターを操作して、「Split Brain」で協力しよう。一方が操作を担当し、もう一方が視覚を担当。しかし、決断は二人で協力して下す！幻影に立ち向かい、真実を明らかにしてHexartureからの脱出を目指そう。

en.name: Split Brain
en.description: Share the same body with a friend in Split Brain. One of you controls, the other one sees, but the decisions are made together! Face the illusion and uncover the truth to find your way out of Hexarture.

floor2.name: Fly Punch Boom!
genres: ローカルマルチプレイヤー
floor2.description: 最高にワイルドなアニメ調バトル！超高速で飛び、対戦相手をぶっ飛ばして高層ビルを突き破り、一撃で惑星をぶっ壊せ！ローカルは最大4人、オンラインは2人までマルチプレイ可能。無限のキャラクターを対象とした Steam ワークショップが登場！

en.name: Fly Punch Boom!
en.description: The WILDEST ANIME FIGHT. Fly super fast, smash your friends through skyscrapers and break the planet with one punch! Up to 4 players local & 2 online. Now with workshop for INFINITE CHARACTERS!

floor2.name: 絶対遵守
floor2.description: 🌐 言語不要 【規則は絶対。破れば即、＂死＂】無人の雑居ビルからの脱出を目指す、一人称視点の短編脱出デスゲーム。ランダムに変化する規則を絶対に守り抜き、ギミックを突破して脱出せよ。

en.name: No exceptions
en.description: 🌐 Language Independent “Rules are absolute. Break them, and you die. No Exceptions.” Escape a building from the 10th floor in this death game. Each floor has prohibited actions. Break a rule and it’s game over. Don’t run. Don’t stop. Don’t look. Learn the rules. Obey them. Escape alive.

floor2.name: クジラゲームオンライン
floor2.shortName: クジラゲームオンライン
floor2.description: 【マルチプレイに対応】 キミはクジラをつくれるか！？ かわいい愉快な海の仲間たちをくっつけて、大きく成長させていくゲームです。 同じ種類の仲間をくっつけると、どんどん成長していきます。 たくさん成長させるほどスコアが大きくなるので、どんどん成長させていこう。

en.name: WhaleGameOnline
en.description: Can You Make a Whale? It's a delightful game where you connect cute sea creatures to make them grow bigger. Single Player and Multiplayer Modes! There are both a single-player mode and a multiplayer mode for competing with friends and rivals from around the world.

floor2.name: 光るだけしかない機械
floor2.shortName: 光るだけしかない機械
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
floor2.description: 光るだけしかない60分のアドベンチャー

en.name: Glow Box
en.description: A 60-minute adventure where all you do is glow.

floor2.name: Cozyrama~コージーラマ~
genres: デザイン＆イラストレーション
floor2.description: 『Cozyrama~コージーラマ~』は心を癒す砂場ゲーム。自分だけの魔法のジオラマを自由に形づくり、好きな色を選び、何百ものアイテムで飾ってみよう。可愛らしい動物たちと一緒に、温かいな世界を広げよう！時間制限も、プレッシャーも無し。ただリラックスして、想像力を開花させよう！

en.name: Cozyrama
en.description: Cozyrama is a peaceful sandbox where you shape your own magical dioramas. Sculpt it, pick the right colors, decorate with hundreds of items and add cute animals. Observe a cozy world grow around you! No pressure or timers. Just relax, unwind, and let your imagination bloom!

floor2.name: オセロ レッツゴー
floor2.shortName: オセロ レッツゴー
floor2.description: オセロレッツゴーは、年齢問わず楽しめる、素晴らしい戦略ボードゲームです。コンピューターAIによる計8つの難易度で、初心者にも上級者にもお楽しみ頂けます！精選された80のエンドゲーム・レベルに挑戦してみて下さい！

en.name: Othello Let's Go
en.description: Othello Let's Go is a beautifully designed strategy board game for all ages. A total of 8 levels of computer AI difficulty, suits for both beginners and experts! More than 100 carefully selected Endgame and Lights Out levels are waiting for you to solve!

floor2.name: Stop and Smell the Flowers
genres: 農場シミュレーション
floor2.description: 日陰の庭でくつろぎながら、花が育つのを眺めましょう。種からは新しい種類の花が突然変異を起こす可能性があります。チャートに従って、100種類以上の花のコレクションを完成させましょう！

en.name: Stop and Smell the Flowers
en.description: Relax in your shady garden and watch the flowers grow. Seeds have a chance of mutating into a new species of flower -- follow the chart to complete the collection of over 100 flower types!

floor2.name: ナンプレ Classic
floor2.description: 紙にペンで書くような味わいと ゲームの遊び易さを両立した カスタマイズできるナンプレ ゲームだけど、紙にペンで書くように遊べるナンプレです。 アシスト機能を無くし、淡々と数字を書き込む事ができます。

en.name: Sudoku Classic
en.description: Customizable Sudoku with the feel of writing with a pen on paper and the ease of playing a video game. It's a game, but you can play it as if you were writing with a pen on a piece of paper. You can customize the assist function to your liking.

floor2.name: Minit
floor2.description: 『Minit』は1プレイ1分で完了する、一風変わった冒険アクション。

en.name: Minit
en.description: Minit is a peculiar little adventure played sixty seconds at a time.

floor2.name: Pesterquest
floor2.description: Embark on a quest of epic importance in Pesterquest, a grimsical episodic visual novel adventure set in the darkly funny Homestuck / Hiveswap universe, created by American author and artist Andrew Hussie.

en.name: Pesterquest
en.description: Embark on a quest of epic importance in Pesterquest, a grimsical episodic visual novel adventure set in the darkly funny Homestuck / Hiveswap universe, created by American author and artist Andrew Hussie.

floor2.name: ダンジョンキーパー 2 （英語版）
floor2.shortName: ダンジョンキーパー 2 （英語版）
floor2.description: 悪こそ至上の楽しみ

en.name: Dungeon Keeper™ 2
en.description: Bad guys have all the fun. Discover your dark side as you build an evil underground kingdom and defend it against the forces of good.

floor2.name: ８番出口
floor2.description: あなたは無限に続く地下通路に閉じ込められている。 周囲をよく観察し、「８番出口」まで辿り着こう。

en.name: The Exit 8
en.description: You are trapped in an endless underground passageway. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach "The Exit 8".

floor2.name: Machinika: Museum
floor2.description: 博物館へようこそ！このムードある宇宙規模のパズルゲームには、地球外に起源を持つ、美しくも謎めいた機械が登場します。論理的思考と観察眼を駆使して、それらを修理しましょう。機械が持つ物語を読み解き、以前の持ち主に何があったのかを解き明かすのです。

en.name: Machinika: Museum
en.description: Welcome to the Museum! Machinika Museum is a mystery game where you discover beautiful and mysterious machines of extra-terrestrial origins in an atmospheric galaxy-spanning 3D puzzle game. Will you be able to understand their stories and discover what happened to their previous owner?

floor2.name: 棄海：忘れられた深海都市
floor2.shortName: 棄海：忘れられた深海都市
floor2.description: 『棄海』はメトロイドヴァニア系の探索型アクションゲームです。深海ガーディアン「プランティー」になって、相棒のジャベリン型メカジキロボットを操作、海底都市に侵入した変異モンスターと戦いながら、新アトランティスに隠された秘密を見つけ出す。

en.name: Pronty
en.description: Guide Pronty and its Javelin partner Bront as it defends the once great city of Royla. Explore the deep sea, fight mutant sea creatures, and discover the secrets behind this new Atlantis in this beautiful action-packed adventure.

floor2.name: Xanadu Next
floor2.description: Whenever mist hangs over Lake Orwell, sailors catch sight of a phantom castle just out of reach. As they draw near, it fades away, leaving only questions for all who have seen this “Castle Strangerock.” Now, you must aid your charge in uncovering its secrets...even if it costs you your very soul.

trailers.name: Boundary Between This World and Xanadu Next

en.name: Xanadu Next
en.description: Whenever mist hangs over Lake Orwell, sailors catch sight of a phantom castle just out of reach. As they draw near, it fades away, leaving only questions for all who have seen this “Castle Strangerock.” Now, you must aid your charge in uncovering its secrets...even if it costs you your very soul.

floor2.name: Disneyland Adventures
floor2.description: Disneyland Adventures allows fans of all ages to explore Disneyland park, enjoy adventures based on 18 popular attractions, engage in 100 challenging quests, and interact with 35 beloved characters. Disneyland Adventures is your ticket to the magical world of Disneyland right in your living room.

en.name: Disneyland Adventures
en.description: Disneyland Adventures allows fans of all ages to explore Disneyland park, enjoy adventures based on 18 popular attractions, engage in 100 challenging quests, and interact with 35 beloved characters. Disneyland Adventures is your ticket to the magical world of Disneyland right in your living room.

floor2.name: Rock Simulator 2
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 穏やかな放置型アドベンチャーで共にくつろぎましょう。静かな世界で岩となり、協力プレイで友人とリラックスし、周囲に広がる自然の営みを見守りましょう。心地よい放置ペースで秘密を発見し、環境を形作っていきましょう。

en.name: Rock Simulator 2
en.description: Unwind together in a peaceful idle adventure. Become a rock in a serene world, relax with friends in co-op, and watch nature unfold around you. Discover secrets and shape your environment at a soothing, idle pace.

floor2.name: Keyboard Chaos
floor2.description: 2,692個のキーキャップ。32台のキーボード。散らかったデスクがひとつ。正しいキーキャップを見つけて本来の位置にはめ込み、四角も丸も、すべてのキーボードを完成させよう。探して、整理して、混沌が完璧なキーボードに生まれ変わっていく心地よさを味わおう。

en.name: Keyboard Chaos
en.description: 2,692 keycaps. 32 keyboards. One messy desk. Find the right keycaps, match them to their positions, and complete every keyboard, square or round. Search, organize, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning chaos into perfectly assembled keyboards.

floor2.name: Onde
floor2.description: スムーズなサウンド・サーフィング・プラットフォームゲームで、波に乗ってどこまでも。幻想的な音楽に合わせて、抽象画風の静穏な風景を泳ぐように巡りましょう。心安らぐ音空間に身を任せ、生命に想いをはせる旅へ。

en.name: Onde
en.description: Catch a wave in this smooth sound-surfing platformer: Let ethereal tunes carry you fluidly through serene abstract landscapes, tune into soothing sound spheres and revel in a meditative journey of life.

floor2.name: Bouncing Duck Simulator
floor2.description: Bouncing Duck Simulator allows you to fulfill your wildest dreams. Bouncing a rubber duck around, bouncing a pink rubber duck around, bouncing... more ducks? Don't be shy, you gotta bounce them all!

en.name: Bouncing Duck Simulator
en.description: Bouncing Duck Simulator allows you to fulfill your wildest dreams. Bouncing a rubber duck around, bouncing a pink rubber duck around, bouncing... more ducks? Don't be shy, you gotta bounce them all!

floor2.name: ゴブリン・ノーム・ホーン
floor2.shortName: ゴブリン・ノーム・ホーン
floor2.description: 手描きのグラフィックと愉快でシュールな世界観の2D横スクロールアクションゲーム

en.name: Goblin_Gnome_Horn
en.description: A 2D side-scrolling action game with hand-drawn graphics and a fun, surreal world view.

floor2.name: That Flipping Mountain
genres: 精密プラットフォーム
floor2.description: A physics driven parkour game inspired by "Getting Over It" and "Jump King". Flip, ski, and dive yourself up a massive mountain of stuff. Fall down, rage, get up, shake it off, parkour-on!

trailers.name: That Flipping Mountain - Just Flip Mode

en.name: That Flipping Mountain
en.description: A physics driven parkour game inspired by "Getting Over It" and "Jump King". Flip, ski, and dive yourself up a massive mountain of stuff. Fall down, rage, get up, shake it off, parkour-on!

en.name: Deadlock
en.description: Deadlock is a multiplayer game in early development.

en.name: Dear Passengers
en.description: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

en.name: Light No Fire
en.description: A game about adventure, building, survival and exploration together. Set on a fantasy planet the size of Earth.

en.name: Fable
en.description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

en.name: Blight: Survival
en.description: Blight: Survival is a PvE Action-Horror Game set in a brutal medieval world. Play in solo or team-up with up to 3 friends as you face monsters and men in a tense battle for survival. How far are you willing to go?

en.name: Resident Evil Veronica
en.description: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

en.name: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000
en.description: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

en.name: Kingmakers
en.description: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.

en.name: Witchbrook
en.description: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

en.name: ILL
en.description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

en.name: Soulframe
en.description: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.

en.name: ARK 2
en.description: Survive the past. Tame the future. Suddenly awakened on a primal world filled with dinosaurs and humans struggling for dominance, you must team-up with legendary heroes to confront powerful dark forces. Saddle up, and join the definitive next-gen survival experience with ARK 2!

en.name: METRO 2039
en.description: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

en.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
en.description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

en.name: Unrecord
en.description: Unrecord is a single-player FPS that tells the story of a tactical police officer from the perspective of his body camera. As you work to solve a complex case, you'll need to use your tactical and detective skills to succeed.

en.name: Persona 4 Revival
en.description: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

en.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
en.description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

en.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
en.description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

en.name: Tides of Annihilation
en.description: Tides of Annihilation is an action-adventure game steeped in the legends of King Arthur. When an otherworldly invasion shatters London, Gwendolyn, a lone survivor, embarks on a desperate quest to fight back and uncover the truth that lies beyond the veil.

en.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
en.description: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

en.name: Chrono Odyssey
en.description: Chrono Odyssey, A Next-generation Action MMORPG. Game features include awe-inspiring visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, a vast and intricately designed seamless open world, dynamic action-based combat mechanics based on time manipulation and extensive customization.

en.name: State of Decay 3
en.description: Play as a community of survivors, build up your settlements with friends, and destroy zombies in State of Decay 3, the latest in the franchise from developer Undead Labs.

en.name: Vindictus: Defying Fate
en.description: Experience intense action brought to life with diverse, unique characters. Read your enemy’s attacks and strike back for maximum impact in Vindictus: Defying Fate. Immerse yourself in signature combat and a gripping narrative.

en.name: NAKWON: LAST PARADISE
en.description: NAKWON is a multiplayer zombie survival game set in urban South Korea. Venture into the city in the dead of night, and manage your shelter by day. Scavenge resources in a city crawling with the infected and hostile survivors. Survival is the only rule - trust no one, not even the living.

en.name: Chronicles: Medieval
en.description: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

en.name: Family Time
en.description: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

en.name: Railborn
en.description: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

en.name: Rooted
en.description: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

en.name: Persona 6
en.description: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.

en.name: Alkahest
en.description: Alkahest is an Action-Adventure RPG set in a murky medieval world. Where satisfying melee combat with highly interactive environments takes center stage. Explore realistic locations, learn alchemy and make a name for your family.

upcoming.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State

en.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State
en.description: A horror-infused extraction shooter for squads of three. Crush monster hordes with devastating firepower in co-op PvE, or take on rival squads for The Vertex in PvP. Choose your battle, push as far as you dare, and make it out alive.

en.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
en.description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

en.name: Emberville
en.description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

en.name: Showa American Story
en.description: Showa American Story is an RPG steeped in retro pop culture. In the late 1980s, a dominant Japan culturally colonized America. Resurrected from the grave, Chigusa Choko embarks on a road trip of combat, exploration, and growth across a world both absurd and strangely familiar.

en.name: Ardem
en.description: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.

en.name: Falling Frontier
en.description: Conquer a vast procedurally generated star system in Falling Frontier, a sci-fi RTS where intel and logistics are decisive factors. Design ships and raid enemy supply lines, lay minefields and construct recon stations, and ambush enemy forces within asteroid fields and nebulae.

en.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
en.description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

en.name: Guild Wars 3™
en.description: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder.

en.name: Haunted Paws
en.description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

en.name: HUNGER
en.description: HUNGER throws you into the chaos of plague-ravaged Napoleonic Europe. This multiplayer extraction RPG blends brutal melee and ranged combat with deep long term character progression, questing and crafting. Scavenge for resources, battle unspeakable horrors, and outlast rival Living.

en.name: Kaiju Cleaner Simulator
en.description: Clean up the aftermath of epic Kaiju battles in this brutal first-person simulator for 1-4 players. Carve up giant monster corpses, extract rare organs, operate heavy machinery, and wash away the blood and toxins polluting the city streets!

en.name: puzzlez - a shapez game
en.description: puzzlez - a shapez game is an easy to learn, hard to master puzzle game about building shapes in compact 3D spaces. Solve handcrafted puzzles with multiple solutions, from simple production chains to complex logistical problems. Design, share, and play custom puzzles with an ever-growing community.

en.name: Skarven
en.description: Fallow fields birth strange life. Battle botanical abominations and a fanatical militant cult as you journey through a dark and distorted vision of the Danish countryside. Experience deep lore, thick atmosphere, and razor sharp mechanics in this raw yet refined classical narrative FPS.

en.name: RESISTOR
en.description: A turbocharged narrative-driven adventure RPG featuring open-world exploration, stunt-infused racing, and explosive vehicular combat! Build up your team and unravel a twisting story as you compete to take down an oppressive mega-corporation and its enigmatic director.

en.name: Space Hauler
en.description: Space Hauler is a space flight sim set around Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Fly your spacecraft using realistic aerodynamics and orbital mechanics, take on contracts, and build your career as a pilot-for-hire.

en.name: Supermarket
en.description: Run your own supermarket in this chaotic co-op/singleplayer simulator! Stock shelves, manage customers, and overcome quirky challenges in a lively, customizable store. Work solo or team up with friends for hilarious, fast-paced fun.

en.name: Art of the Rail
en.description: Spiritual remake of the classic transport tycoon games. Build a profitable transport network and grow your worlds economy, either on your own in singleplayer or in multiplayer whether cooperatively or competitively.

upcoming.name: Can you cook my last meal?

en.name: Can you cook my last meal?
en.description: A game where you become a prison chef and cook the final meals of death row inmates. Read each prisoner’s profile, choose ingredients, prepare the meal, and talk with them.

en.name: The Apocalypse
en.description: The Apocalypse is a low-poly sandbox survival shooter combining fast-paced combat with light survival. Scavenge, craft weapons and vehicles, build shelters, and fight zombies and mutants. Play solo or co-op with friends, with Mod support planned for the future.

en.name: CRETE
en.description: Fight against the Ancestors and other biopunk creatures. Use their DNA to build your own procedural weapons, find a friend and combine your skills to be even more powerful. The further you go, the better rewards you will get for the next run. It is up to you to reveal what is up there in the north.

en.name: The Edge of Water
en.description: An adventure game about a girl leading her floating village on the course of a great fish migration. Herd sea creatures, protect them from danger, and surf across both beautiful scenery and troubled waters.

en.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
en.description: In this nostalgic 2D action-platformer roguelike, awaken in a world of forgotten game characters as a hero with no memory of his past. After failing to save a nearby village from destruction, can you rise, rebuild, and discover the true meaning of being a hero?

en.name: Litchi Town
en.description: Enter the Litchi Town, a game that turns the rural life into a canvas for your creativity. Forge bonds with the townies and engage in the timeless art of designing your own farm and cultivating friendships. As the seasons shape the landscape, savor the simple pleasures and tranquil moment.

en.name: Soul Blade
en.description: "Soul Blade" is a 2D platform action game with classic hand-drawn 2D animations that provide a smooth and immersive visual experience. The combat system is built around the "swordplay" mechanism, delivering intense and exhilarating battles.

en.name: Afterconflict
en.description: A brutal tactical FPS focusing on unflinching realism and equipment accuracy, set during the twilight days of what was once the Cold War.

en.name: Shadowstone
en.description: A tactical roguelite where survival comes down to what your heroes can do together. Choose your heroes, build your power, chain your skills, and break the run. Play solo or co-op, up to 4 players.

en.name: PlanetSmith
en.description: A sandbox survival RPG set on fully spherical hex worlds. Crash-land on an uncharted planet, craft and build to survive, uncover what infected the solar system, then build a ship and fly seamlessly to other planets. No loading screens. No edges.

en.name: Quatiica Motorsports
en.description: An anti-gravity racing game set in 2096. Gear up and take flight across multiple race types: soar over mountain ranges on Fore Thrusters, rush through narrow canyons in an Endurance Prototype, or dive underwater in a Pulse Sprinter. We are racing in the new 90s!

en.name: Dark Island: Faded Memories
en.description: Ride dragons across forgotten islands. Explore the ruins of a world that fell long ago. Battle monsters and fallen soldiers lurking in the dark. Play solo, or team up with friends in co-op. Nostalgic graphics and style that bring back the magic of childhood.

en.name: Power Drill Massacre
en.description: A DRILLING good time!... a VHS era, Lowpoly Slasher

en.name: MARINES VS GOD
en.description: One of you is God. Up to four friends are Marines on a mission. Finish the objective before time runs out while your friend summons monsters, drops meteors, and ruins your plans. Can the Marines outsmart God?

en.name: I SHALL NAME THE DEAD
en.description: The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

en.name: Airport Renovator
en.description: Take matters into your own hands and renovate a run-down airport! You have the right tools for the job, so clean up and restore this place. Open up the loot crates and collect pieces of equipment that you can arrange according to your plan. Make this airport an international giant!

en.name: Please Insert Disc
en.description: Please Insert Disc is a horror game about navigating the underbelly of a 2000's era gaming console to restore its functionality, but awakening something in the process. From the creators of Home Safety Hotline.

en.name: Restaurant Simulator
en.description: An immersive first-person sim that lets you taste the life of a restaurant owner. Be a chef, a waiter, an interior decorator. Open your own place and make it #1 in the town!

en.name: Zombotron Re-Boot
en.description: Fight with zombies, with evil robots and other monsters to survive in the crazy world of Zombotron. The action takes place on an unknown planet, which over time was abandoned and forgotten by people. Find and rescue survivals to discover the mystery of the mysterious planet together.

en.name: Pact, Passion, Puchimon!
en.description: Journey across a continent teeming with diverse monsters! Capture them through intense bullet-hell battles and grow stronger together. With an in-depth nurturing system, you can build bonds with your "Puchimon" to unlock exclusive storylines and turn them into your ultimate battle partners!

en.name: Family Land - Farmer Simulator
en.description: Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Renew an old farm. Give new life to the farmland. Take care of the animals. Convince Old Bill that together you can do more. A humorous story about the struggles of a townie who decided to become a farmer.

en.name: Shelf Heroes
en.description: Blast rogue toys with wacky weapons in this fast-paced Roguelite FPS! Mix & match toy parts to assemble your Shelf Hero, discover powerful perk combos, and explore a giant House. Play solo or with friends in 3-player co-op!

en.name: They Speak From The Abyss
en.description: Lost in a cursed world. Surrounded by the tortured souls of the damned. Is the only way out truly a baptism in blood? Face demons head-on, talking or fighting your way through this surreal, psychological horror, dungeon crawling RPG.

en.name: Godshard Chronicles
en.description: Godshard Chronicles is a top-down action RPG based in the Godshard novels universe with music by famed composer Noriyuki Iwadare. Inspired by titles such as The Legend of Zelda, Grandia, and the Mana series. Fight in action-packed battles and explore a sprawling world either solo or with a friend!

en.name: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
en.description: A brutal action game set in a collapsing sci-fi nightmare. Battle biomechanical mutants, traverse shifting landscapes, and uncover fragments of your lost mind as you descend into a twisted post-apocalyptic world.

en.name: Solar Smash: Annihilation
en.description: Solar Smash: Annihilation is the ULTIMATE sandbox simulation game. Unleash galactic chaos with lasers, meteors, black holes, and many more crazy weapons. With stunning graphics, smooth gameplay and an exciting arsenal of destructive tools – the universe is your playground!

en.name: Solaria
en.description: Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.

en.name: Void Soul Awakening
en.description: Void Soul Awakening is a hyper fast action roguelite blending hack and slash combat, third person gunplay, and sorcery. As a wandering soul trapped in an ever shifting cosmic prison, master a massive arsenal, swap between powerful classes, adapt to every run, and fight your way to the Keeper.

en.name: Phantom Doctrine: The Cabal
en.description: Explore the world in Phantom Doctrine: The Cabal to work out a dangerous terrorist organization in various locations around the globe. From exotic rainforests and secluded corners to bustling large metropolises.

en.name: Cozynauts
en.description: Clean, Construct and Chill. Join the ranks of the Cozynauts, an intergalactic non-profit organization focused on cleaning up planets polluted by The Corporation.

en.name: Twinkle’s Galactic Tour
en.description: Travel the galaxy and bash enemies to the beat in this 90's anime styled, low-poly, musical platforming adventure! Jump from planet-to-planet, collect 'em all in classic platforming-style zones, and meet the locals in big, open city hubs full of activities, side-quests, and mysteries.

en.name: Beyond The Plastic Wall
en.description: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.
